# **Why I'm Running for Congress,
and Why I Need Your Help**
> Each morning during the campaign, Team Thelander wakes up to the headlines of the day from around Maine and the nation, gathered and organized by one of our many loyal and talented volunteers. _**These news items highlight the reason why I am running for Congress.**_
>
> A European land war involving a nuclear-armed nation. Record high gas and food prices. Soaring heating oil prices. The disappearance of our energy independence. Empty shelves in grocery stores. Baby formula shortages. The porous southern border. More than 100,000 deaths from drug overdose. Under-funded and under-staffed police departments resulting from relentless negative portrayals by the media. Rising crime rates. An increasingly politicized military and the debacle of the Afghanistan withdrawal. Soaring inflation...
>
> I could go on, but you get the picture. These headlines serve as a daily reminder of how little the average, hardworking American's voice seems to matter to those in Washington. We need to make things right. Under the current progressive administration, with the unwavering support of my opponent, America appears to be in a free fall toward disaster.
>
> _**That is why I need your help.**_ We need to raise enough money to put up a decent fight and continue getting my name out there. Election Day is less than 6-months away, and we have a lot of work to do. With your help, we can turn things around!
>
> As I travel the district, I can tell you what they are saying about a Red Wave coming in 2022 is true! Click the donate button to help make sure Maine's First Congressional District rides that Red Wave to victory!

I am the *official* Democratic candidate for the most flippable U.S. Senate seat in the country.
#
**PENNSYLVANIA — THANK YOU FOR MAKING ME YOUR DEMOCRATIC NOMINEE FOR U.S. SENATE!!!!!!!! 😭😭 **
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220517-3?refcode=em20220517-5879&refcode2=5879_434096_bWYWxz&akid=5879%2E434096%2EbWYWxz)
I am so deeply honored, Derek.
And trust me, I do NOT take being the *official* Democratic candidate for the most flippable U.S. Senate seat in the country for granted. 😁
Nor do I take going up against the Republicans in November lightly.
**Because if you’ll allow me to be brutally honest for a second, 2022 is going to be a hard year for Democrats.**
A typical Democrat, running a typical campaign, is going to struggle. To win PA in 2022, we’re gonna have to do things differently. Dems cannot run the same playbook that has failed in years past. 💯
So this is my promise to you. My campaign is going to turn the map on its head + compete for votes in all 67 counties. We can *not* cede county after county to the Republicans.
**Every County, Every Vote. There’s just no other way to win PA.**
Look, I can win in places other Democrats can't because I’m a different kind of Democrat.
**I’ve already run + won statewide, not only in the primary, but in a general election, too. And I can do it again in November, Derek.**
I just need your support, which is why I have to ask:
[**Will you donate any amount right now and become a Fetterman for PA Founding Donor? We need to raise a *lot* of money right now in order to beat the Republicans + flip PA blue to save our Democratic majority.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220517-3?refcode=em20220517-5879&refcode2=5879_434096_bWYWxz&akid=5879%2E434096%2EbWYWxz)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220517-3?amount=5&refcode=em20220517-5879&refcode2=5879_434096_bWYWxz&akid=5879%2E434096%2EbWYWxz)**
Quite frankly, we wouldn’t be where we are today without the grassroots support of folks like you, Derek. Every email you opened, post you shared, or voter you talked to helped us get to this point.
Over the past year, this campaign has built a true grassroots movement across PA, powered by over 500,000 individual donations + an average donation of just $27.
No dirty money. No corporate PACs. Everything we do is fueled by the donations of people who believe in me + our campaign. **That’s the kind of grassroots enthusiasm we need over the next few months to flip this seat blue.**
[**Will you make a donation today and become a Founding Donor for our campaign to send me to the U.S. Senate? Our campaign is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you + we need all hands on deck if we’re going to flip this seat in November.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220517-3?refcode=em20220517-5879&refcode2=5879_434096_bWYWxz&akid=5879%2E434096%2EbWYWxz)

One last time from me, Gisele, Karl, Gracie, August, Levi + Artie: Thank you, thank you, thank you. I hope this campaign makes you as proud as it makes us. 🎉❤️
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

**CONTACT: Trevor Naglieri**

---
| **Statement by Jeremy Shaffer on PA-17 GOP Primary Victory**
---
| **Gibsonia, PA** – Jeremy Shaffer released the following statement on his electoral victory today in Pennsylvania's 17th Congressional District Republican Primary:

_"Thanks to our amazing team across Western Pennsylvania and beyond, tonight we secured the Republican Nomination for Pennsylvania's 17th Congressional District! I am incredibly grateful to all the primary voters who put their trust in me today and want to thank my Republican opponents for a spirited competition and their willingness to step forward and serve.

"This election is about the future of our region and country, and the voters will have a clear choice in November. Unfortunately, Democrats in Washington have caused runaway spending and skyrocketing inflation, soaring violent crime, and weak leadership that's threatening our national security, and my general election opponent will toe that party line at the expense of Pennsylvanians.

"It's clear from talking with voters and witnessing the results tonight that Pennsylvanians are ready for a fighter and problem-solver in Washington who will stand up to the career politicians, fix our economy, and take our country back. I will be an independent voice for Western Pennsylvania taxpayers and always accountable to the people.

"Thank you again, to my wife Stacey, our five children, volunteers, and supporters throughout the district, for your prayers, time, and votes. We will not let you down."_
---
| **ABOUT JEREMY SHAFFER**
Jeremy is a proven leader in business and our community. He stands for small, efficient government that defends our freedoms and provides opportunities for all. Jeremy married his high school classmate and prom date Stacey. They have been blessed with five children born and raised here in Western Pennsylvania. Jeremy is passionate about working to make our community and country even better. Jeremy earned a Ph.D. in Electrical and Computer Engineering from Carnegie Mellon while his wife, Stacey, completed her Medical Residency and Fellowship at the University of Pittsburgh.

A problem-solver and entrepreneur at heart, while at Carnegie Mellon, Jeremy co-founded a company committed to improving our crumbling roads and bridges. As a small business owner, Jeremy understands the importance and challenges of dealing with government regulations and taxes while growing revenue and managing personnel.

As a Ross Township Commissioner and Board President, Jeremy was a common-sense voice that fought for taxpayers, led the fight for reforms, and opposed big-government policies. Jeremy also served his community as a Northland Library Foundation Board member, Northern Tier Library Board Member, founder of Walk/Bike Ross, and coach on numerous youth sports teams. Jeremy is also a man of faith and is active in his local church having served as both an elder and a deacon previously. Above all, Jeremy wants to ensure that our great country continues to provide an abundance of opportunities for future generations. In his free time, Jeremy enjoys the wonderful Western Pennsylvania outdoors with biking, running, and hiking.

The 17th Congressional District is located in Western Pennsylvania and contains all of Beaver County and much of the Allegheny County suburbs outside the city of Pittsburgh. To learn more about Jeremy and his campaign for Congress, please visit [www.JeremyShaffer.com](https://JeremyShaffer.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=168b3aab49521aba8263d07fe&id=d7aa7f347e&e=32107e7cf1).

# Bill McSwain Responds to GOP Gubernatorial Nomination of Doug Mastriano
**West Chester, Pa.** **\-- **Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, had this to say in response to the GOP Gubernatorial nomination of Doug Mastriano on May 17:
---
|
> **_"I_** _** have congratulated Doug Mastriano on his victory today and I wish him well in the General Election. **_**_It will take an all-out commitment to defeat Josh Shapiro, who would be nothing more than Tom Wolf 2.0. _**
>
> _**I am grateful to have been a part of this incredible process, and for the chance to share my vision for a safer, freer, more secure Pennsylvania with so many supporters and friends. **_
>
> **___While this result was not what we had hoped for, the people have spoken, and I will always respect the will of the great people of Pennsylvania. I entered the race because I love Pennsylvania, and I will always be committed to doing whatever it takes to create a better future for the communities that I love." _**
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as U.S. Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming a prosecutor, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=a3a67d1d97&e=b1ec95759b)

name: American Update
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9005%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=BOE9gdd6Dt7fOkK0XHT7Rw&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c22524%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rzfA%2fC89NhMltzRaU1uUow&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c22535%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kTtoRZJtLmdC7X%2fr9GkbIA&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c22535%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kTtoRZJtLmdC7X%2fr9GkbIA&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Dear friend,

Recently, the Department of Homeland Security
announced the creation of a so-called "Disinformation Governance
Board" (i.e., a "Ministry of Truth"). While they claim it will
combat Russian "misinformation," its goals could be much more
sinister.

The Democratic establishment, as well as some
establishment Republicans, support this propaganda arm of the
federal government because they're afraid that we will think for
ourselves. They're afraid we'll challenge their power.

We cannot let this administration continue to
threaten our First Amendment rights and undermine our
Constitution. I need your support to protect our fundamental
freedoms.

This board is not unexpected. For years, the
establishment has worked to shut-down alternative viewpoints.
Now, we're seeing these anti-democratic principles form the
foundation of a government body.

Will you chip in to our fight for free
speech?

Contribute $20 >>

Contribute $30 >>

Contribute $50 >>

The United States is not supposed to be a
dictatorship. We need to come together and make clear to this
administration that we can not and will not be silenced.

Thank you,
Tulsi Gabbard

---
|
---
| With Dawson County voters turning out at the polls in record numbers, Dawsonville Mayor Pro Tem John Walden is encouraging his constituents to join him in supporting Jake Evans for Georgia's 6th Congressional District. "My friends and neighbors here in Dawsonville want a conservative fighter to represent us in Congress, and Jake Evans fits the bill," City-councilmen John Walden said. "As with all of the national issues important to our community, we agree with President Trump that Jake's the best choice. A MESSAGE FROM ASHLEY
This morning I woke up incredibly proud of all we accomplished against formidable odds. We distributed literature to 12,500 households, mailed over 38,000 mailers, sent thousands of handwritten postcards to difficult to reach areas of the district, put out 1250 yard signs, sent 60,000 text messages, and spent 132 hours at the polls across 5 counties!
Thank you to all of the volunteers, voters, and supporters of this campaign. While we didn't get the outcome we desired, we ran a campaign with integrity and focused on the people and the issues.
So let's keep talking about climate change. Let's hold the people we do elect accountable for securing our future and the well being of our communities. And let's demand action on climate change!
Enjoy the moments of this campaign, from our announcement, to filing day, to that first cold canvass, to all of the volunteering and canvassing that followed, to Primary Day, and the last moment of the campaign when we closed it down at 7:30pm at North Regional Library in Durham!

subject: Reminder: We Did It!
body:
13,000 Signatures and I'm on the ballot!
| | | |
---
---
|
---
WE DID IT!
Just a few short weeks after I announced my candidacy for Lieutenant Governor, our campaign has submitted more than 10,000 certified signatures to the Secretary of State, allowing me to qualify for the ballot.
I'd like to thank you for your support and for all you did to make this happen. We had volunteers spread out in cities and towns across the state collecting signatures for weeks. It was hard work, but we got it done before the deadline!
I decided to get into this race because I know Geoff Diehl and I represent the best ticket to help restore faith and confidence in our state's government. We will fight hard to keep your taxes low and protect your rights and freedoms. We believe in the importance of your child's education, and your right to make decisions about curriculum. And, as a nurse, I believe we are in the best position of any candidates to help shape our state's pandemic policies the right way.
With the MassGOP Convention now just days away, our campaign has amazing momentum and I believe we are poised for a great victory!
But, in order to get there, I continue to need your help.
If you stand with Geoff and me, would you please consider making a donation in support of my campaign today? Here's the link to donate online: [Support Leah! ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QTnyepG_kreWPEmqUGks9QSFNtqPipl4Gm1sPs-7VlW2ROgwbhto82OxOzRDfGexnJczgwXR0K5_lR9gV9V1iMiFc4rDzc1RmAAe5q5MLtdlVou_s14kWQs2BXRod6EC57ZO8dgqBQ6KtPwcGG6qtaqHq40f8yOxHWH-oa7xrINAc4JT-EXHhw==&c=1jBG4AcM5J6nROdfdDqTC5y-9JMLgo5d8Hax0yqkMWafQ1dUBHSEQw==&ch=AWxTWwtmKRRWlfKII64KuV8xG444u-etRPC1y4fxkJ-uIZRkf3JsWw==)
And, if you are a delegate to the MassGOP Convention this weekend, I humbly ask for your vote to be your next Lieutenant Governor.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your continued support. Geoff and I are in this race to win it, and I am confident that with your help, we will prevail.
Sincerely,
Leah Cole Allen

name: Great America Update
subject: The Great Reset and socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6927%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=xB4myxP3lTvyRpr1lz%2bJ2w&sysid=1)
| | | This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61255%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=90lp0AyTv2iGJvSHNd8s3A&sysid=1)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61256%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ytGGd6mZBX%2berKtFzOLRDg&sysid=1)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61256%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ytGGd6mZBX%2berKtFzOLRDg&sysid=1)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Tuesday, May 24th is a critical day for Southern Minnesota.
Republicans in the First District will head to the polls to decide who they'll send to Washington to represent them in Congress.
Kevin Kocina is the only candidate in the race who hasn't made a career out of politics. He's running to represent everyday Minnesotans, not cozy up to high ranking politicians in D.C.
Kevin Kocina is the only veteran in the race. He's the only candidate who knows first-hand the struggles our veterans face and how to fix them.
Kevin Kocina is the only blue-collar worker in the race. There's no better candidate to represent hard-working Minnesotans than Kevin.
If you're ready for a fresh new face to represent you in Congress, make plans to vote for Kevin Kocina next Tuesday, May 24th.

Fellow Conservative:

The 2022 mid-term elections are about lots of issues: inflation, crime, border security, the 2nd Amendment, election integrity, Big Tech, energy, the right to life, and free speech.
But more than anything, 2022 is about OUR KIDS.
Who do we trust with our children: their parents, or the woke socialist elite? Make no mistake: that is THE issue of 2022.
Help protect our kids. Support the Freedom Caucus candidates with a generous contribution.
The anti-American Left has declared war on America's moms and dads. They don't think parents should have a say in kids' education. They don't even think parents should know what public schools are teaching.
This makes sense since what they want to teach is that America is evil, some races are better than others, and boys can get pregnant.
They think government employees and doctors should be able to drug and even mutilate children without telling their parents! They have even covered up violent crimes committed by young men in girls' bathrooms to keep parents and taxpayers in the dark about their trans
extremism.
Left-wing officials refuse to prosecute crime - putting children and families at risk on our streets.
And Joe Biden and his woke socialists have run up so much debt for their inflationary spending that kids will never be able to pay it off.
Fight the Left's war on our nation's children!
The conservative movement is growing every day because the Left has decided parents are their enemies. Parents want their kids to know the Truth about God, America, freedom, and boys and girls - Democrats see that truth as a threat.
The Left started this war on families - parents now have to finish it. The 2022 election is a Crusade for Children against the woke, anti-American, anti-family elites poisoning our classrooms, entertainment, social media, and politics.
Democrats have decided YOUR kids belong to THEM. We need to remind them that THEIR OFFICES BELONG TO US!
We need to boot out of the House every anti-parent Democrat, and every Republican afraid to take the fight to them.
Please join the Crusade for Children with an urgent donation!
Join the Freedom Caucus in the fight to end the Left's war on parents and put children and families first again.
Thank you for considering this request and for doing so much to help fight for America's future.

Sincerely,

# THE BECKWITH BRIEFING

#### News & Notes
from the Campaign
---
| **VOTE SATURDAY, MAY 21st **
---
| | **I'm counting on you**** !**
---
| The others are counting on ad clicks and TV air time...
**My secret weapon to win is YOU!
Keep telling your friends & neighbors about the Fight for Virginia’s Future!**
---
| You know what carries more influence than air time on Fox News, TV ads, and dozens of mailers? **Your good word.** That’s what will get District 10 to the polls to **vote for me**. Other candidates in this race seem to have a lot of money and time to become fixtures on the national news, so you have to ask... who’s opinion are they really after? I’ve spent my campaign talking with faith groups, homeschool families, and freedom-loving patriots **right here in District 10** , because**I’m not looking for national attention. I only want VA10’s confidence in my plans** to get us back on the right path to prosperity, security, and liberty. **Your good word to friends and family, neighbors and colleagues is what’s going to send me to Washington so I can get to work for you!** So **keep on sharing** about my Fight for Virginia’s Future and**I’ll see YOU at the polls on Saturday, May 21st!**

I am officially the Democratic nominee for Pennsylvania’s 17th District.
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45451603/346026021/-2143054902?refcode=em_fr_2022.05.18_b1_cd_all-nd&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YmYzZmVmOS1iNGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qMdwrUQ-MxynbGTv5FnikB1rHpRolVPXYL89E5sxAQE=) Hi Derek,

I wanted to take a moment to share the good news. **Thanks to working folks from across Beaver and Allegheny Counties, I am officially the Democratic nominee for Pennsylvania’s 17th District!**

[**We’re now in the general election, and we have a tough road ahead. Can you chip in today to help power our campaign through November?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45451605/346026023/-2143054902?refcode=em_fr_2022.05.18_b1_cd_all-nd&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YmYzZmVmOS1iNGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qMdwrUQ-MxynbGTv5FnikB1rHpRolVPXYL89E5sxAQE=)

As a father, voting rights lawyer, Iraq War veteran, and union organizer, I got in this race to fight for a future that leaves no one behind and a government that puts people first.

From day one, this campaign has been about fighting for our common good and a government that serves all of us: rebuilding our manufacturing and infrastructure, union jobs, health care that isn’t a rip off, and more.

**Now, our people-powered movement takes the next step toward the general election.**

What I see from the radical right is a party willing to attack our democracy when they lose an election, a party eager to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , and a party ready to ship your jobs overseas to make a penny more in profit for their corporate bosses.

But earning the Democratic nomination shows that when we come together, we can accomplish anything. We built a labor-backed coalition of moderates and progressives together ready to take on the radical right. **And I know that come November, we _will_ defeat the radical right here in PA-17 once and for all.**

[**If you’re able, please chip in a few dollars to help us kick off the general election strong.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45451607/346026025/-2143054902?refcode=em_fr_2022.05.18_b1_cd_all-nd&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YmYzZmVmOS1iNGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qMdwrUQ-MxynbGTv5FnikB1rHpRolVPXYL89E5sxAQE=)

Derek, I was born here in western Pennsylvania. I believe in this community, and I am tired of seeing the places and people I love get left behind. This is our chance to fight for the future we want, and I’m ready to do the job in Washington.

**This is our moment, Derek, and we can’t afford to waste it.**

Thank you, so much, for your support. Let’s get to work.

Chris Deluzio __ |

# Ed's Thoughts After the Primary
---
| |
---
| Can't say I'm pleased with yesterdays results. Nonetheless, Governor Brad Little appears to have a mandate from the people of Idaho. I must respect that and honor the will of the voters.
Everyone knows that my team and I worked tirelessly to implement a better direction for our state. But we were whipped by the incumbent. I'll be praying for Idaho.
Thank you everyone for the support and encouragement. Many of you donated your time and money. It is something I will never forget.
So many people across this state profoundly affected me and my family. I hope to have made a minor positive impact on Idaho.

subject: [important] Marco Rubio's vicious attacks

body:
I'm reaching out to set the record straight.
| | |
---
Friend, Marco Rubio is attacking my 27 years of law enforcement service, so I'm reaching out to set the record straight.

Back in 1983, **I answered a call to serve because I loved my community and wanted to protect it from harm.** And while I was working the midnight shift, Marco Rubio was plotting his trajectory as a career politician.

But the problem is, some voters have only heard Marco Rubio's lies about me, and I need more resources to share my story of service with more Floridians before it's too late. Please understand, friend: How quickly I'm able to correct the record for voters will make or break this election.

**[If you can spare $5, will you donate before midnight to help me counter Rubio's attacks?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45453233/346032761/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3226-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYTVhOWYyNS1iOWQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2QXkCov-DwRCkieSp0ytqSkpEJlUCuKKvFxGtgLp2PM=)**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45453234/346032762/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3226-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYTVhOWYyNS1iOWQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2QXkCov-DwRCkieSp0ytqSkpEJlUCuKKvFxGtgLp2PM=)
I was one of eight women in a class of 30 when I joined the police academy – but I always remembered what my mom had told me: "Be the best you can be, even if people say you don't belong."
And when it came time to choose a class president, one of the other women in our class convinced me to run. I was nervous, but I went for it – and I won by a landslide.

Thank you, thank you, thank you.

My heart is full of gratitude. Because of you, because of the team that we built, and because of grassroots power across the great state of Oregon - we have won the Democratic Primary for Governor.

This would not have happened without you. I believe campaigns are a team effort. Your support has been amazing!

I’m energized by the fight ahead of us. There is so much at stake. The Supreme Court is preparing to overturn 50 years of precedent and restrict abortion access across this country. We are in the most critical decade to address climate change and protect our communities on the frontlines of its impact. We need to fight for working Oregonians, protecting them on the job and putting more money in their pockets to take care of their families. And we need to tackle our housing crisis head on, get our neighbors off the streets and build enough affordable housing to meet the needs of our communities.

I know we can meet these challenges successfully together.

| | Peter, I'm as alarmed as you are by the nation's baby formula shortage, which has left so many Long Island families struggling to feed thier children. And this crisis makes clear that rising prices, shortages and inflation is not only an economic disaster, _it's a humanitarian and health care disaster._ **That's why I'm pressing federal and local officials to take action _now_ to address the crisis. ** **First, we have to get prices under control.** Price gouging is a sinister, immoral act that is harming families across Long Island and families all across New York. I've called on Nassau County to create an independent hotline for residents to directly report price gouging. I am also urging the Nassau County Department of Consumer Affairs to investigate any and all instances of merchants overcharging for baby formula and hold price gougers accountable. **We also need the federal government to step up.** That's why I'm calling on the federal government to allow the importation of baby formula to help alleviate the current supply strain. We need to get baby formula to families – immediately. **We also need more competition in the baby formula industry.** Right now, there are only three baby formula producers in the entire country. More competition will mean lower prices for families, but just as importantly, if something goes wrong with one of these companies (and it did) we won't have a shortage crisis on our hands. It's a no-brainer. **Taking advantage of people during times of crisis is unacceptable; taking advantage of families trying to feed their infants is immoral.** We must hold price gougers accountable and our federal government needs to step up and help address the baby formula crisis now. clean_body: | | | Peter, I'm as alarmed as you are by the nation's baby formula shortage, which has left so many Long Island families struggling to feed thier children. And this crisis makes clear that rising prices, shortages and inflation is not only an economic disaster, it's a humanitarian and health care disaster. That's why I'm pressing federal and local officials to take action now to address the crisis. First, we have to get prices under control. Price gouging is a sinister, immoral act that is harming families across Long Island and families all across New York. I've called on Nassau County to create an independent hotline for residents to directly report price gouging. I am also urging the Nassau County Department of Consumer Affairs to investigate any and all instances of merchants overcharging for baby formula and hold price gougers accountable. We also need the federal government to step up. That's why I'm calling on the federal government to allow the importation of baby formula to help alleviate the current supply strain. We need to get baby formula to families – immediately. We also need more competition in the baby formula industry. Right now, there are only three baby formula producers in the entire country. More competition will mean lower prices for families, but just as importantly, if something goes wrong with one of these companies (and it did) we won't have a shortage crisis on our hands. It's a no-brainer. Taking advantage of people during times of crisis is unacceptable; taking advantage of families trying to feed their infants is immoral. We must hold price gougers accountable and our federal government needs to step up and help address the baby formula crisis now. For all of our families, the time for action is now. name: Mel Franklin
subject: Rushern Baker for Governor
body:
http://secure.ngpvan.com/t_OakHAu1Eyexxm3ZVTwZw2 [http://secure.ngpvan.com/t_OakHAu1Eyexxm3ZVTwZw2]

Friend,
I’m reaching out today because I believe that the Baker Navarro ticket for Governor and Lt. Governor is how we save Maryland. As their press releases and new TV ad acknowledge, we are in a crisis of violence. In Baltimore alone there have been over 2,000 murders, mostly African American, in the last 8 years.
The problem is getting worse, and Rushern Baker and Nancy Navarro are the only candidates for Governor and Lt. Governor with the experience and ability to actually DO something about it if they are elected. When Baker was Prince George's County Executive, he reduced violent crime by 58%. The Baker-Navarro campaign has already released the most comprehensive equity and inclusion agenda for black families that I have ever seen. And Baker’s proposals to declare a state of emergency in Baltimore City, create a statewide Transforming Maryland Initiative, patterned after his successful violence reduction strategy as Prince George's County Executive, and establish an incentive program to encourage businesses to hire returning citizens are three more concrete examples of steps to rid our streets of this plague of violence.
Bottom line, we need to make sure they win in the Primary, and then in November. If you’d like to join me in supporting these incredible candidates, please consider making a donation today. [http://secure.ngpvan.com/t_OakHAu1Eyexxm3ZVTwZw2]

name: John Fetterman
subject: Let’s gooo
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Let’s get to work.
#
Derek, last night, the people of Pennsylvania chose me as their Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate. I couldn’t be more honored, grateful + determined.
Now, a whole new fight begins.
All I have to say is: **Let’s f*cking go, Derek.**
[**Today is the first day of the general election, and our goal is to bring in 15,000 Founding Donors by 11:59 p.m. to ensure we have what it takes to flip Pennsylvania. Can I count on you to be one of the 15,000 folks we need to chip in + jumpstart this campaign?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220518-1?refcode=em20220518-5886&refcode2=5886_434096_C16KGp&akid=5886%2E434096%2EC16KGp)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220518-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220518-5886&refcode2=5886_434096_C16KGp&akid=5886%2E434096%2EC16KGp)**
Our commanding election results yesterday prove we have what it takes to flip this Senate seat. From Butler to Bucks, last night our Every County, Every Vote campaign came to life.
Yes, 2022 is going to be a hard year for Democrats. Yes, a typical Democrat, running a typical campaign, is going to struggle. **But I’m not a typical Democrat.**
I can win in places other Democrats can’t + I won’t cede county after county to Republicans just because they’ve gone red in the past.
Working people living in every part of Pennsylvania know I’m on their side. They know I’ve fought for them the last 20 years of serving this Commonwealth, and they know I’ll fight like h*ll for them in Washington.
To be brutally honest, the biggest obstacle we face in this race is being outspent. If we can raise enough to take on the Republicans and the (many) right-wing super PACs who will flood PA with tens of millions of dollars, we’ll have what it takes to win.
[**Be a part of this fight by chipping in today and establishing yourself as a Founding Donor of our campaign for U.S. Senate. Together, we can beat the Republicans, flip this seat + strengthen our Democratic Senate majority.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220518-1?refcode=em20220518-5886&refcode2=5886_434096_C16KGp&akid=5886%2E434096%2EC16KGp)
I can’t do this without you + I am so, so grateful you’re here.
Let’s do this,
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220518-5886-footer&t=1&refcode2=5886_434096_C16KGp&akid=5886%2E434096%2EC16KGp)**

Peter,

May is Mental Health Awareness Month – a time to raise awareness, fight stigma, and advocate for policies that support people with mental health challenges and substance use disorders.

Here in Rhode Island, the rates of people living with mental health disorders is higher than the national average. Nearly 1 in 4 Rhode Islanders report experiencing mental health disorders, and the COVID-19 pandemic has only made things worse. The impact on the mental health of children is particularly troubling, with the American Academy of Pediatrics declaring a National Children’s Mental Health Emergency.

Demand for mental health services is surging in our state, and inadequate funding and reimbursement rates have led to a shortage of qualified mental health providers to meet the needs of Rhode Islanders. There are simply not enough providers to care for people, and patients face long wait lists for treatment or can’t access treatment at all.

We need to take action to ensure every person living with a mental health disorder has access to the care they need. In Congress, Seth would support legislation to increase access to high-quality, affordable treatment, increase services to children in schools, and work to end the stigma attached to mental health and substance abuse disorders.

If you or someone you know is struggling with mental health or substance use disorders, you can call the National Alliance on Mental Illness hotline at **800-950-NAMI** or visit the **[Mental Health Association of Rhode Island for a list of resources.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45461262/346054518/204895049?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNDAxZGQ5Zi1jM2Q2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5rNuKHpL3h2-Uw7XGRGtGTahbDRExiGSrcHqCouxXZI=&emci=ae787aee-b2d6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=0401dd9f-c3d6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=15384964)**

subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2ztv5odiqsfth74bquahhubldgt64nj61ed7jliog_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c3ie6or6cph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbpn0spk69geap1m69q67cbkm1o7ap9gsjg7bcti6djbdcph6kqjas3meqon2stn6v970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666ob6p30etj6cc9imdj3fc5lclp2bs)
This sponsored message from Deroy Murdock is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z4aehu63ftvflq4v9l6rpbn0em2eoo0d1o4cfkj8_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c3ie6or6cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zpjcan6psjmc6b9t9hnuhoqli0adl8qct257isoo_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c3ie6or6cph2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2ztljkqqgrd8r0me2s0tr1gjaf2sofhhuf02l5hp8_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c3ie6or6cph2bs)** Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! Best regards, Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

With child care providers and women who make clear the need to protect abortion access. For them, and for all Pennsylvanians, the stakes of our Senate race this year could not be higher.

I’ve said before that I am committed to doing whatever I can to ensure we flip this seat in November, and that work continues today as I ask you all to unite with me to support our nominee for the U.S. Senate, Lieutenant Governor John Fetterman.

Fellow Conservative: The 2022 mid-term elections are about lots of issues: inflation, crime, border security, the 2nd Amendment, election integrity, Big Tech, energy, the right to life, and free speech.
But more than anything, 2022 is about **OUR KIDS**.
Who do we trust with our children: their parents, or the woke socialist elite? Make no mistake: that is THE issue of 2022.
**[Help protect our kids. Support the Freedom Caucus candidates with a generous contribution.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdkkmsqd2i0v95bueikomlmhmpcqbuooqcefver0_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c3ie6o72cph2bs)**
The anti-American Left has declared war on America’s moms and dads. They don’t think parents should have a say in kids’ education. They don’t even think parents should know what public schools are teaching.
This makes sense since what they want to teach is that America is evil, some races are better than others, and boys can get pregnant.
They think government employees and doctors should be able to drug and even mutilate children without telling their parents! They have even covered up violent crimes committed by young men in girls’ bathrooms to keep parents and taxpayers in the dark about their trans extremism.
**Left-wing officials refuse to prosecute crime – putting children and families at risk on our streets.**
And Joe Biden and his woke socialists have run up so much debt for their inflationary spending that kids will never be able to pay it off.
**[Fight the Left's war on our nation's children!](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zl7svnpjj2cqbo9do7154e2ljdg1varas5qauk70_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c3ie6o72cph2bs)**
The conservative movement is growing every day because the Left has decided parents are their enemies. Parents want their kids to know the Truth about God, America, freedom, and boys and girls – Democrats see that truth as a threat.
The Left started this war on families – parents now have to finish it. The 2022 election is a **Crusade for Children** against the woke, anti-American, anti-family elites poisoning our classrooms, entertainment, social media, and politics.
Democrats have decided YOUR kids belong to THEM. We need to remind them that **THEIR OFFICES BELONG TO US!**
We need to boot out of the House every anti-parent Democrat, and every Republican afraid to take the fight to them.
**[Please join the Crusade for Children with an urgent donation!](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1d1e2c1etmqskng4ls136cnu42gcvp6r3442ea0_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c3ie6o72cph2bs)**

This weekend, I was deeply angered and saddened by the news of the senseless gun violence across this country that targeted communities of color. The continued attack against the Asian American, Black and other communities of color in Buffalo, Dallas, and Orange County clearly shows that we are in dire need of sensible gun laws, and this begins at the federal level.
My heart broke for the families of the victims in Dallas, as a gunman shot 3 people in a salon. I could not help but think of my mother, who was a nail technician at a salon very similar to the one in Dallas. These victims were someone’s parent, friend, and loved one. And no one should live in constant fear of losing them.
Asian Americans and other communities of color are being targeted everyday with violence and racist rhetoric, and Congress needs to do more to ensure that serious measures are being taken to protect us.
The first step we need to take is enforcing sensible gun laws at the federal level: increasing background checks, enforcing Red Flag laws, requiring a nationwide gun registry, and prohibiting the sale of assault weapons.
For far too long, gun safety has become highly politicized. Now is the time for us to make a change.
Victoria

The continued attack against the Asian American, Black and other communities of color in Buffalo, Dallas, and Orange County clearly shows that we are in dire need of sensible gun laws, and this begins at the federal level. My heart broke for the families of the victims in Dallas, as a gunman shot 3 people in a salon. I could not help but think of my mother, who was a nail technician at a salon very similar to the one in Dallas. These victims were someone’s parent, friend, and loved one. And no one should live in constant fear of losing them. Asian Americans and other communities of color are being targeted everyday with violence and racist rhetoric, and Congress needs to do more to ensure that serious measures are being taken to protect us. The first step we need to take is enforcing sensible gun laws at the federal level: increasing background checks, enforcing Red Flag laws, requiring a nationwide gun registry, and prohibiting the sale of assault weapons. For far too long, gun safety has become highly politicized. Now is the time for us to make a change. Friend,

Yesterday saw another round of primary election results from other states.

Just a reminder, California’s Primary election is June 7th. All of you should have received your ballot by now, and this is a gentle reminder to fill it out and send it in. Obviously, I want your vote, but there are many important county-level races as well across the district. Those votes are important too!

**The big lesson so far from looking at other states is that Trump’s support has been important but not omnipotent.** Radical Trumpists are still in the driver’s seat, but they are not winning every races. Madison Cawthorn lost his seat in North Carolina, and Trump’s support for Mehmet Oz for Pennsylvania Senate only got him into a still-too-close-to-call-knife-fight for first with a bit over 30% of the vote.

Speaking of Pennsylvania, I’m a bit bummed that Connor Lamb lost, but I wish Lt. Gov. Fetterman the best of luck in the General Election going forward. Lamb’s first election in 2018 saw him beat a Republican in a R+11 district. Our district is R+12. His win there, as a centrist veteran, was an inspiration to me. That said, Pennsylvania is a purple state (R+2), and Democratic Primary voters have decided that Fetterman can win. Moreover, I like that Fetterman is not a typical politician: we need changes in Washington.

**What does all this that mean for my race against LaMalfa? It means that there are many Republicans who still have political identities distinct from Trump -- Republicans who refuse to give their party up to a narcissistic draft-dodger who can't admit that he lost an election. Democrats must win these voters over if we have any chance of taking LaMalfa’s seat. On our side, we must continue consolidating Democratic voters who are hungry for change.**

All of you should have received your ballot by now, and this is a gentle reminder to fill it out and send it in. The big lesson so far from looking at other states is that Trump’s support has been important but not omnipotent. Radical Trumpists are still in the driver’s seat, but they are not winning every races. Madison Cawthorn lost his seat in North Carolina, and Trump’s support for Mehmet Oz for Pennsylvania Senate only got him into a still-too-close-to-call-knife-fight for first with a bit over 30% of the vote. Speaking of Pennsylvania, I’m a bit bummed that Connor Lamb lost, but I wish Lt. Gov. Fetterman the best of luck in the General Election going forward. Lamb’s first election in 2018 saw him beat a Republican in a R+11 district. Our district is R+12. His win there, as a centrist veteran, was an inspiration to me. That said, Pennsylvania is a purple state (R+2), and Democratic Primary voters have decided that Fetterman can win. Moreover, I like that Fetterman is not a typical politician: we need changes in Washington. What does all this that mean for my race against LaMalfa? Democrats must win these voters over if we have any chance of taking LaMalfa’s seat. | Newt calls Trump-endorsed 6th District candidate "smart, hard-working, courageous conservative leader" In the final week of the campaign, former Speaker Newt Gingrich made the case for Jake Evans to represent the 6th Congressional District - the district he represented when he emerged as one of the greatest American conservative leaders. "Jake Evans is the kind of hard-working, courageous and intelligent young man who can really help America for decades to come," Gingrich said in his video message. "He's young enough that he can grow into a real national leader, he's courageous enough that he can make a real difference, and he's smart enough that he can understand the great challenges we face as a country today." Gingrich outlined the problems facing the country today: rising gas prices, the cost of food, 19,000 people a day streaming illegally across the border, increasing crime rates. "You know if we're going to compete with China, we're going to have to have dramatic, serious effort," Gingrich said. "Jake Evans is capable of making that kind of an effort. That's why I think it's very important to elect Jake Evans to Congress. That's why I'm for him." "Help Jake Evans help America." Jake said Gingrich is more than a national conservative hero to him. He's a mentor. "I've had the incredible honor of learning my entire life at the foot of one of the greatest conservative leaders in the history of the nation," Jake said. "The passion and intensity of support he's poured into this campaign means more to me than I can ever express. I promise to carry on his legacy in Congress, fighting for an effective America First agenda that will put our country back on the right track. We're working hard every day to reach 6th District voters, and to have the strong support of Speaker Gingrich and President Trump has put rocket fuel into our campaign's momentum."

name: Nikki Haley
subject: Great advice from a legendary coach 👉
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Stand for America PAC
body:
| | Peter,

Herschel Walker's primary election for U.S. Senate is next Tuesday, May 24th.

In addition to knowing about a candidate's policies and background, I think it's helpful to know a little about the individual too. I wanted to send you these five quick questions we asked Herschel to tell us a little about himself.

**Take a look at his answers below.** _**[If you'd like to help Herschel Walker win in Georgia and flip the Senate RED, please consider chipping in to his campaign here.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60417450:6XNBpPoNO:m:1:3253819041:8F814AA4A92B0C4851433B3F3DC24A28:r "If you’d like to help Herschel
Walker win in Georgia and flip the Senate RED, please consider chipping in to his campaign here.")**_

---
| | | **Question 1: What 's the best piece of advice you've ever been given?**

**Herschel:** _My former coach, Coach Tom Landry of the Dallas Cowboys, said, "If you take something out of society, then you need to put something back in." When I was starting out in my athletic and business careers, I had numerous_
---
| | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60417450:6XNBpPoNO:m:1:3253819041:8F814AA4A92B0C4851433B3F3DC24A28:r)
---
_mentors, pastors, and friends who took me under their wings and encouraged me both personally and professionally. I want to pay that forward and use the many opportunities God has blessed me with to help bless others._

**Question 2: Best and worst part of running for office?**

**Herschel:**_I tell people this all the time -- running for office is the greatest thing I have ever done in my life. I love Georgia and feel called by God to give back to the state that has given me so much. Julie and I are working some long days, but we love traveling across the Peach State meeting with thousands of Georgians and hearing their stories._

**Question 3: Favorite memory on the football field?**

**Herschel:**_My favorite memory is playing for the University of Georgia in the National Championship game against Notre Dame in 1981. I dislocated my shoulder and ran over to the sidelines gripping my arm. Our trainer said I would need to sit out, but I asked him to pop my shoulder back in place. He did, so I was able to go back in and play. We ended up winning the game, and I was proud to win a National Championship for my home state alongside my teammates!_

---
| | | **Question 4: Dog or cat?**

**Herschel Walker:** _I went to UGA -- so I have to say DAWG! My dog Cheerio is absolutely incredible. He's even on Twitter! You can follow him on Twitter @CheerioWalker._
---
| | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60417450:6XNBpPoNO:m:1:3253819041:8F814AA4A92B0C4851433B3F3DC24A28:r)
---
**Question 5: What do you love most about Georgia?**

**Herschel:** _Definitely the people. It has been amazing to see the outpouring of love and support across Georgia. We have been so encouraged to see folks from across the political spectrum respond to our message and let us know that they are on Team Herschel. Georgians love America, love God, and love our freedoms that we all enjoy. We have found that what unites us is far greater than what divides us._

Herschel's Senate race in Georgia is one of the toughest - and most important - races in the country. If we're going to defeat Democrat Senator Raphael Warnock in November, we must make sure Herschel wins his Republican primary next Tuesday!

_**[If you have anything to spare, please consider chipping in a donation to Herschel Walker's campaign today.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60417450:6XNBpPoNO:m:1:3253819041:8F814AA4A92B0C4851433B3F3DC24A28:r "If you have
anything to spare, please consider chipping in a donation to Herschel Walker’s campaign today. ")**_

My very best,

Nikki R. Haley

---
| | | [Support Herschel Walker Now](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60417450:6XNBpPoNO:m:1:3253819041:8F814AA4A92B0C4851433B3F3DC24A28:r)
---
|

---
**_A Note From Nikki:_** Growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys' Club and my opponent thought women shouldn't be in politics. People thought I was too brown, too female, too young, too conservative, too principled. I said: Too bad. I was inspired by great women who broke barriers and defied expectations, women like Margaret Thatcher and Jeane Kirkpatrick. That's why I wrote this book. body:
Ted Budd was one of Trump’s first endorsements because he’s proven himself a loyal foot soldier.
#

Thank you for putting your faith in me as the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in North Carolina. It’s humbling.
The Republican primary has been called, and our opponent is Trump-endorsed Congressman, Ted Budd.
I’ll tell you more about his radical and harmful agenda in a moment, but with the general election officially underway, I need to ask for your immediate support to start strong.
[**If you can, please make a $3 donation to our campaign right now to become a Founding General Election Donor and flip this seat.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-may22?refcode=em220518-1-ma&refcode2=897.357359.adV7LU&t=1&akid=897%2E357359%2EadV7LU)
Look, there’s a reason that this was one of the first Senate races Donald Trump got involved in this cycle. Ted Budd was one of Trump’s first endorsements because he’s proven himself a loyal foot soldier.
Ted Budd pushed Trump’s Big Lie and voted to overturn the election on January 6. He wants to ban abortions — even for cases of rape, incest or where the mother’s life is at risk.
He voted against the bipartisan infrastructure plan and sided with Big Pharma by voting against legislation to lower prescription drug prices. And he believes in tax cuts for big corporations and oil companies already making record profits paid for by us, while our families struggle with higher costs.
Ted Budd is a DC insider who looks out for himself and the big corporations and special interests who fund his campaigns, not North Carolina.
He must be stopped, and right now, the latest polling shows us tied at 45%. The Senate majority could come down to a handful of votes in this race, and we’re counting on a lot of grassroots support to make sure we have the resources to win.
[**Can you please make a $3 donation to our campaign to flip North Carolina’s open Senate seat today? We need as many Founding General Election Donors as possible to prove that Democrats have what it takes to win and expand the majority.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-may22?refcode=em220518-1-ma&refcode2=897.357359.adV7LU&t=2&akid=897%2E357359%2EadV7LU)

name: Tobias Read
subject: Thank you
body:
By now you’ve probably heard that things did not go our way last night.
---
| | Peter, By now you’ve probably heard that things did not go our way last night. I’ve congratulated Tina Kotek on her victory and told her we’ll work hard for the future our kids deserve. Both of us care deeply about Oregon, and we promised to keep in touch. I am so grateful to you for your support. You’ve been behind us from day one of the campaign, and together we brought so many critical issues to the forefront of Oregon politics. The urgent need to address the homelessness crisis; rising gun violence; and helping our students regain the ground lost during the pandemic. It’s important that we continue to raise our voices and work for the Oregonians who are counting on us. Everything we care about is on the line in this election – from reproductive rights to economic opportunity to fighting climate change. It’s critical that we come together and move forward toward the future we want and that our kids need. Thank you so much for everything you’ve done for me and my campaign. We couldn’t have done any of this without you. And I hope you will keep in touch, because we still have lots to do together. Thank you,

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45469870/346092890/823540626?refcode=ea.50af22b1-dfd6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ms=ea.50af22b1-dfd6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MGFmMjJiMS1kZmQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HrPV0EWts6stIK2fiWUI6YD7JAYkOC9xnXEfwElnRMU=&emci=d00828ab-dfd6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=50af22b1-dfd6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=1049176)
Peter, Last night, Cheri Beasley became North Carolina’s nominee for the United States Senate. She’s the partner I need in Washington to secure our right to vote, protect our environment, fight for women’s reproductive freedom, and deliver for the people of our state. So I am personally asking you to help her start the general election strong: **[Please split a donation between Cheri Beasley’s campaign for U.S. Senate and Team Cooper today. It’s going to take a lot of hard work to flip this seat blue, so we’re counting on you to join us in this fight.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45469871/346092891/-1871358334?refcode=ea.50af22b1-dfd6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ms=ea.50af22b1-dfd6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MGFmMjJiMS1kZmQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HrPV0EWts6stIK2fiWUI6YD7JAYkOC9xnXEfwElnRMU=)** Having appointed Cheri Chief Justice of our State Supreme Court, I know her to be smart, fair, and honest – always putting justice and the people first. She is the right person at the right moment to be our next U.S. Senator. National Republicans are already on the air attacking her with a shameful ad meant to mislead voters about her decades of service to our state. Far-right super PACs have pledged nearly $50 million to try to buy this seat for their extremist candidate. name: Malcolm Kenyatta
subject: I remain optimistic about tackling the challenges we face
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Malcolm PAC
body:
Friend,

When we joined this race a year and a half ago we knew the hill we had to climb would be high, but we knew we had to climb. Too much was at stake to not try.

We didn’t climb to make history, but yesterday we did as the first openly gay man to ever appear on a ballot for US Senate and as the second African American in Pennsylvania history to ever seek the Democratic nomination for US Senate.

And it’s difficult to say, but despite our historic climb it looks like we’ve come up short.

Before I go too far, I want to just say thank you to my husband Dr. Matt — for your friendship, your partnership, and your love — thank you. And to everyone who chipped in a few bucks, who made phone calls, sent texts, knocked on doors or volunteered: we couldn’t have made it this far without you.

You joined this campaign because you knew that standing up and fighting inspires someone else to stand up as well. Each of us adds pressure to a status quo that will one day fall.

And while this didn’t end the way we planned, I remain optimistic about tackling the challenges we face.

And to the young and marginalized people who have watched this race. Let me say this: don’t wait your turn. Don’t listen to the cynics. The time for turns is over. Now is the time for a new day, new vision, and new leadership. Run for office.

Thank you so much for the opportunity to run this race, it means the world to me that so many of you were a part of this historic campaign.

My very best,

Malcolm

I’m ringing the alarm...
Fellow American,

subject: We're on the offensive
body:
| | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/citizensrenewingamerica.com/were-on-the-offensive?e=17913c7d6d)
---
| | |
---
| | |
#
Friends,

Our country finds itself in the midst of several crises.

Hundreds of thousands of illegal immigrants are pouring into the U.S. through virtually open borders. In March alone, there were more than 221,000 migrant encounters.

Meanwhile, the radical left is grooming, **_yes grooming our children_** to adopt their divisive, inappropriate, and dangerous sexual, racial, and political ideologies.

To solidify their recent gains, the Biden administration is weaponizing the federal government to usurp state control over elections. And Big Tech continues to censor conservatives who don’t share their radical left-wing agenda.

_**But we’re on the offensive**_. As I told President Trump in April, we have solutions to stop the radical left’s destructive, woke agenda.

**Here is a roundup of CRA’s biggest initiatives** :
---
|
---
| **The Solution to the Border Crisis: Declaring an Invasion**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=8d2c564bf9&e=17913c7d6d)
---

**What’s happening right now at the US-Mexico border is nothing short of an invasion**. I appeared on Fox News recently to argue just that. [Watch my full appearance.](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=d846daa22b&e=17913c7d6d)

I discussed how border state governors like Greg Abbott of Texas and Doug Ducey of Arizona can take immigration enforcement into their own hands by declaring this an invasion. _It’s a Constitutional solution to this border crisis_.

In fact, as CRA Senior Fellow Ken Cuccinnelli mentioned in another recent [appearance](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=cc693e81c4&e=17913c7d6d) on Fox News, the border crisis won’t stop until border state politicians declare this an invasion.

President Biden’s open borders policies have resulted in a record number of encounters at the US-Mexico border this spring. Unless things change, in 5 days, the Biden Administration is going to lift Title 42, which would effectively incapacitate border patrol agents from doing their jobs.

This crisis is about to get much worse. **Border states MUST fight back**.

**CRA POLICY BRIEF** : [How States Can Secure the Border](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=77c19fcd22&e=17913c7d6d)
|
---
| **It’s Not a Myth: They’re Grooming Our Children**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=dd73a43da5&e=17913c7d6d)
---

Thanks to the parent revolution there’s been a lot of attention focused on the topic of educators “grooming” children in public schools. The left and their media allies want to dismiss this as an unfounded moral panic.

**Let's be clear, America's institutions are grooming your children**.

Parents, concerned citizens, and elected officials must go on offense to protect the innocence of our kids from groomers. Grooming is not a myth. Our recent policy brief reveals the dark and disturbing truth. We expose the five stages of a groomer’s engagement with their potential victims.

**Parents must be aware of the signs** so they can prevent their child from being indoctrinated.

**CRA POLICY BRIEF** : [Yes, America’s Institutions are Grooming Your Children](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=71115ff70e&e=17913c7d6d)
|
---
| **Victory in Court: We Helped Texas Fight Back Against Big Tech**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=73fbd83776&e=17913c7d6d)
---

**Some positive news from Texas**. The 5th Circuit Court of Appeals made a ruling on May 11 that lifted the stay on Texas big tech law HB 20.

This means that Facebook, Twitter, and other social media platforms can no longer censor those they disagree with who live within the borders of Texas.

**This is a big win for CRA**. We were proud to have filed an amicus brief and to have made an impact in this case. A shout out to our allies at the Claremont Institute’s Center for Constitutional Jurisprudence who co-signed as well.

**CRA Amicus Brief** : [NetChoice v Paxton in Texas’ 5th Circuit](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=936d49c024&e=17913c7d6d)
|
---
| **CRA Meets with Trump at Mar-a-Lago**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=60cfd867a9&e=17913c7d6d)
---

We were honored to meet with President Trump in late April at Mar-a-Lago.

We attended an incredible reception where we discussed the policies that will shape the future of our country.

**I was proud to tell President Trump **that The Center for Renewing America has created a first rate, America First organization that will build upon and strengthen the movement he started.

We posted more photos from the reception on our Twitter account.
[See them here.](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=f6b05175bf&e=17913c7d6d)
|
---
| **Join The Fight**
---
| The left won’t stop and neither can we. We’re fighting on all fronts to save our country and put America First. We’re willing to put in the hours and do the work because saving America is worth it.

[Considering joining the fight with a generous contribution](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=d92ee85034&e=17913c7d6d).

You’ll be hearing from us again soon with another roundup of our biggest initiatives.

Thanks to your help, we'll keep fighting back.

Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President
Center for Renewing America

Next week, May 22-28, the World Health Organization is holding a meeting of its World Health Assembly. They will be voting on amendments (submitted by the Biden administration) to something called the International Health Regulations (IHRs) that will unequivocally decimate our national sovereignty. These regulations are related to the Global Pandemic Treaty you’ve likely heard about, but the treaty won’t be voted on until 2024. The first vote happening is the vote on all of these amendments. In short, these amendments to the IHRs are the back door to imposing the treaty without going through the process required to approve a treaty. Therefore, this week, we are contacting Congress and asking them to publicly oppose these amendments and to apply whatever pressure they can to ensure their rejection. We will also contact employees and appointees of HHS who are most likely the delegates to the World Health Assembly. [**Use our AlignAct campaign**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-LOxQdjdmg) to email (and more) all of those people with just a few clicks, and help us **Save Our Sovereignty!** Be sure to pass the link on to your networks as well!

However, the White House is now appealing it, trying to argue that the CDC did have the power to impose it, because they don’t want the decision to set precedent. It’s obvious that the CDC never had this power, so [**use our campaign to let them know it is time to back off and drop their appeal!**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._ECBJ0w-rbxZGhyB8mTg) **Secure our Border NOW!** [**Use our AlignAct campaign**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.org/c/7/eyJhaSI6NDkxMDk0ODksImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiVDE4bzlMbmV1akhoazkxUVFRIiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjIxMzgtZWVlMDE5YTg1NGEyNGQ4MmE2M2I0YTQ1YjA4MmMxNDEiLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiNSIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vYWxpZ25hY3QuY29tL2dvL2JvcmRlci1zZWN1cml0eS1ub3c_bWlkPTQ1MzM1JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/RMBR4pbcdEYQBiDXkdbaVg) to quickly and easily contact five Democrat Senators who have publicly opposed Biden’s plan to end Title 42, but who aren’t taking action to protect our border.

| | [ ](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=897d53f17d&e=5d8d80652b)

| | , **I've made myself clear in this campaign.** [**I support the legalization of recreational and medicinal cannabis in Texas**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=d8d412cabc&e=5d8d80652b) and will lead a statewide effort to make this happen. Why is that? Here are a few of the reasons: **For medical treatment.** Cannabis provides our veterans and those suffering from illness a wellness alternative to addicting opioids. **For jobs.** Legalized recreational and medicinal cannabis will be a money maker for Texas. How does 30,000 permanent jobs, $1.1 billion in revenue to add to the state budget and $300 million statewide savings for police and prosecutors sound? It sounds like smart progress to me. **For criminal justice reform.** And finally, I must simply ask: how many young lives, principally lives of color, are we going to permanently burden and put in private prisons so that people can make a profit off of their incarceration? **We, as Texans, must stand up and demand better.** [](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=941f57a8eb&e=5d8d80652b) I have campaigned all across our state for nearly two years sharing my plan to legalize cannabis in Texas and protect responsible cannabis use by adults. [**Will you stand with me and support my campaign to be your next Attorney General?**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=a318cb9b1f&e=5d8d80652b) We must demand common sense solutions from our elected officials. Cannabis legalization is a solution that will make a huge difference in the lives of the people of Texas. **For medical treatment, jobs, and most importantly, for criminal justice reform. **

Vote for me on May 24 as your next Attorney General, and next year I will testify before the Texas House and Senate in support of cannabis legalization.

[**Donate today and vote on or before May 24 to help me continue to spread this message all over our state.**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=05435582f7&e=5d8d80652b) Onward, Joe

subject: My abortion story
