body:
My Sisters and Brothers,

With the leaked Roe v. Wade Supreme Court opinion, the time felt right to share my abortion story. Why? Because, back then, I was the type of person who would have suffered most. The same is true today if Roe is overturned: poor women, Black women, single women, all women will be impacted. Reproductive care is health care!

Read my story: https://www.elle.com/culture/career-politics/a39970976/gwen-moore-abortion-story/

Please take a moment to read my story. Abortion is so important for the future of women, just as it was critical in allowing me to pull myself out of poverty and have the opportunity to get live-changing experience under my belt so I was ready to have more children eight years after my first was born.

If Roe is overturned, you can bet the radically conservative Supreme Court won’t stop there. What will they take away next? Same-sex marriage? Birth control? The fight to keep our constitutional rights under Roe v. Wade has never been more dire. And you can count on me to fight like hell to protect it!

Act now: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gwenmay22?refcode=0518

Together #WeProtect women's rights and #WeRepresent!
-Gwen
Proudly representing Wisconsin's Fourth Congressional District
Proud Co-Lead of the Violence Against Women Act
100% Pro-Choice

The first African-American woman in Wisconsin history to serve in the U.S. House of Representatives, Congresswoman Gwen Moore, took her official oath of office on January 4, 2005. She served in the Wisconsin State Senate from 1993-2004. Before her election to the Senate, Congresswoman Moore served two consecutive terms in the Wisconsin State Assembly from 1989-92. body:
It’s time to pass a Green New Deal.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=417%2E61531%2E5r14I6)
Hello,
Living in Vermont means taking full advantage of all the unparalleled natural beauty we can find right outside our doors. I love that we can take a couple steps outside and find hiking trails, streams, and rolling hills and mountains. It’s a treasure for Vermonters—and it invites folks from around the world to come discover all Vermont has to offer, too.
**But the climate crisis threatens all of this.** If we don’t act with urgency, temperatures will keep rising—damaging not only the environment, but our livelihoods and quality of life. We still have time to fight back, but we need to act—and fast. That’s why I’m an original co-sponsor of the Green New Deal, so we can protect our planet and all that makes Vermont so special.
******[We must keep up the fight, together. If you agree it’s time to pass a Green New Deal, add your name right away.](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-green-new-deal/?source=em_20220518_p_p_gnd&t=4&akid=417%2E61531%2E5r14I6)**********
There are so many common-sense steps we can take right now. We can establish a national renewable energy standard, accelerate the adoption of electric vehicles, create millions of good-paying jobs, and more.
But first, we need Congress to acknowledge the urgency of this moment. Republicans in Washington keep burying their heads in the sand. If they take back control, they’ll only fight for failure. That’s why we’ve got to hold on to our Democratic majorities—and we must expand them to deliver more results.
I’m running for Senate because Vermonters want someone who will champion real climate action representing them.
******[It’s time for a Green New Deal. Add your name if you agree.](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-green-new-deal/?source=em_20220518_p_p_gnd&t=5&akid=417%2E61531%2E5r14I6)** ****
Together, we can take action to solve the climate crisis. Thanks for all you do.
Peter

Peter,

I have some exciting news to share with you this morning: **I’m officially the Republican Party’s nominee for the U.S. House in Oregon’s 4th Congressional District.** Since announcing my second campaign for Congress a year ago, I’ve been lucky to receive the support of so many people both in Oregon and from every corner of the nation.

**As a political outsider,** I am thankful to be selected as the Republican nominee for Oregon’s 4th Congressional District. It’s clear Washington is broken, Joe Biden’s liberal policies are not working, and we need solutions to reduce inflation, lower gas prices, and lower the cost of healthcare while improving access for rural Oregon.

clean_body: I'm excited to share with you that last night I officially became the Republican nominee for U.S. House in Oregon's 4th Congressional District! I stopped a terrortist attack on a train to Paris, now I'm ready to serve the great state of Oregon in Congress. | Peter, I have some exciting news to share with you this morning: I’m officially the Republican Party’s nominee for the U.S. House in Oregon’s 4th Congressional District. Since announcing my second campaign for Congress a year ago, I’ve been lucky to receive the support of so many people both in Oregon and from every corner of the nation. As a political outsider, I am thankful to be selected as the Republican nominee for Oregon’s 4th Congressional District. It’s clear Washington is broken, Joe Biden’s liberal policies are not working, and we need solutions to reduce inflation, lower gas prices, and lower the cost of healthcare while improving access for rural Oregon. That status quo is not working, and now more than ever, we need fresh ideas and new solutions that will help middle-class families in the United States. I’ve been through a competitive general election campaign once before, so I know how expensive the next 5.5 months are going to be. I’m under no illusion the general election race against Oregon’s Labor Commissioner, Val Hoyle, is going to be an easy one for me to win. It definitely will not be. But here again, the choice is clear: Next year the House will have a new member of Congress from OR-4. Will it be someone who: Supports a strong and robustmarket driven economy , or a someone who supports a state-backed government-run system? Supports the Green New Deal, even if that means $10 gas? Or someone who will supportAmerican energy independence? Supports President Biden’s “Build Back Better” socialist spending bill, or someone who supports cutting taxes and letting the people decide how best their money is spent? With control of the House at stake, any one congressional race could provide Republicans with the majority. I have to run like the House flipping RED is dependent on us winning THIS race. So please, ** Thank you for your support over the last year. Thank you very much. | | Hey Peter, I am extremely happy to report that climate champions crushed it in Oregon’s primary election! Starting off, **big congratulations to Tina Kotek, who is now the Democratic nominee for governor!** Tina is exactly who we need as our next governor: climate champion, tireless fighter, and effective leader. She’s motivated by her strong values and her belief that we have an obligation to protect the environment we cherish for future generations. For Tina, climate justice is not a talking point, it’s a top priority. OLCV made its biggest-ever primary election investment in Tina’s race, and we will be with her to get this done in November as well. Next up, **congratulations to Andrea Salinas in winning the Democratic nominee for Oregon’s new, sixth congressional district!** If elected in November, Andrea would be the first Latina member of Congress from Oregon. Andrea’s win still has me energized and grinning from ear to ear. Andrea is in a word: magic. No one but Andrea could go up against over $11 million in spending by a crypto billionaire and win. How did she do it? The same way she worked to put herself through college, and how she’s been a working mom dedicated to fighting for workers, immigrants, our climate and environment, and accessible health care. She never gives up. Last year, OLCV awarded Andrea our “Perseverance Award,” and last night she again proved how she never gives up in the fight for what she believes in. Voters responded by choosing Andrea’s authenticity and rejecting a billionaire’s attempt to buy the race. Climate champions across the state won last night, and it was because of OLCV members and supporters like you. In this primary election, OLCV’s team and volunteers made over 14,000 calls and knocked on about 7,000 doors. We couldn’t do this work without you. OLCV-endorsed candidates couldn’t win without you. Thank you to all the volunteers, the donors, and the voters! And congratulations to all the OLCV-endorsed candidates who won! While we celebrate, we know we are not done yet. The General Election in November is going to be an even bigger challenge. With your help, we are ready for that next challenge. body:
Derek,
Thank you for putting your faith in me as the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in North Carolina. It’s humbling.
The Republican primary has been called, and our opponent is Trump-endorsed Congressman Ted Budd.
I’ll tell you more about his radical and harmful agenda in a moment, but with the general election officially underway, I need to ask for your immediate support to start strong.
If you can, please split a $25 donation between our campaign and CommonGood right now to become a Founding General Election Donor and flip this seat. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_cb?refcode=20220518_CGVA_CB]
Look, there’s a reason that this was one of the first Senate races Donald Trump got involved in this cycle. Ted Budd was one of Trump’s first endorsements because he’s proven himself a loyal foot soldier.
Ted Budd pushed Trump’s Big Lie and voted to overturn the election on January 6. He wants to ban abortions — even for cases of rape, incest or where the mother’s life is at risk.
He voted against the bipartisan infrastructure plan and sided with Big Pharma by voting against legislation to lower prescription drug prices. And he believes in tax cuts for big corporations and oil companies already making record profits paid for by us, while our families struggle with higher costs.
Ted Budd is a DC insider who looks out for himself and the big corporations and special interests who fund his campaigns, not North Carolina.
He must be stopped, and right now, the latest polling shows us tied at 45%. The Senate majority could come down to a handful of votes in this race, and we’re counting on a lot of grassroots support to make sure we have the resources to win.
Can you please split a $25 donation between our campaign and CommonGood to flip North Carolina’s open Senate seat? We need as many Founding General Election Donors as possible to prove that Democrats have what it takes to win and expand the majority. Hey, Peter, it's Daniel (Abby's husband). First, I wanted to say thank you for being a part of this team. We're building a true grassroots movement, and I really appreciate you being a part of it. Second, I wanted to provide a few important updates ahead of Abby's biggest (and public) FEC fundraising deadline at 11:59 p.m. TONIGHT.

Let's back up a bit and talk about Abby's opponent: Sen. Grassley (R-IA), who is facing RECORD-LOW approval with Iowa voters. He's spent his seven terms in office advancing far-right ideologies and sabotaging efforts to help working families. We didn't think it could get much worse, but then he defended Donald Trump's dangerous conspiracy theories and attempts to overturn last year's election. _Then, _he stood on stage with Trump at a rally here in Iowa and wholeheartedly accepted his endorsement. Honestly, as an Iowan and an American, it's been scary to watch.
I know I'm biased, but Abby is the exact opposite of Sen. Grassley and she is exactly the sort of person we need in the Senate. Seeing Abby fight for her community every single day gives me hope. She's everything that a leader should be: caring, passionate, hard-working, determined and ready to sit down and talk with anyone, regardless of their party. **She's the senator our state deserves and the one that it desperately needs.**
That brings me back to the FEC deadline Abby's up against. It's both an opportunity and a challenge: an opportunity to publicly – to the pundits, the media and Sen. Grassley himself – show the strength of this campaign. It's also a challenge to raise what we need to compete, particularly with the Senate Republican campaign arm sitting on $44 million in the bank to attack competitive challengers like Abby.
**We set a goal to blow this fundraising goal out of the water by raising $75,000 – and with just hours to spare before this FEC deadline, we're not quite there yet. I get we're asking for a massive surge in grassroots support, but frankly, it's what it will take to compete and win this race.**

body:
#

Hi friend,
Today is my 35th birthday, and I’m reaching out to ask for your support in contributing to my re-election campaign.
I’m facing a lot of uncertainty these days regarding my election, but I’m used to uncertainty. Growing up poor wasn’t easy. I watched as my mom worked multiple jobs just to put food on the table and make sure I had as great a childhood as I could under the circumstances. She did a hell of a job doing so. When child care was too expensive, I tagged along with my grandma as she cleaned homes, and I learned the meaning of the phrase “it takes a village.” Yet, like so many people from all parts of New York and throughout the country, we still needed assistance from the government to survive.
I’m where I am today because my mom and grandma taught me to dream big and create my own destiny – in spite of the odds and the naysayers. It’s why I fought and worked to make my way to Stanford, then served in the Obama Administration and made it to Harvard Law. When people said a guy who didn’t come from money and wasn’t part of the establishment could never win a House primary over wealthy and well-known opponents, I made history as the first openly gay, Black member of Congress.
Earlier today, my cousin texted me this photo. I had never seen it before. It’s a photo of me at a time when I desperately wanted to change the world – to make it fair for kids like me – but had no idea I could.
As I reflect on my 35 years on Earth, I think of the boy in that picture and how far I have come with your help. My experiences as a child shaped me into who I am today, but I know that others have not been so lucky to beat the unfair odds against them.
That’s why I fight _every single day_ to make sure other children, regardless of the circumstances of their birth, can dream big and achieve their dreams.
The little boy in that photo would be proud of the work we accomplished this term. Cutting child poverty in half and keeping schools and small businesses open through the _American Rescue Plan_. Playing a lead role in passing the largest investment in infrastructure in our nation’s history, which will create millions of good-paying jobs over the next decade. Then co-authoring the _Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act_ to save our democracy from the threats of the far-right.
I will never stop fighting for working people in Congress, regardless of the district.
**[Now, I need your help to continue that fight. clean_body: Hi friend, Today is my 35th birthday, and I’m reaching out to ask for your support in contributing to my re-election campaign. I’m facing a lot of uncertainty these days regarding my election, but I’m used to uncertainty. Growing up poor wasn’t easy. I watched as my mom worked multiple jobs just to put food on the table and make sure I had as great a childhood as I could under the circumstances. She did a hell of a job doing so. When child care was too expensive, I tagged along with my grandma as she cleaned homes, and I learned the meaning of the phrase “it takes a village.” Yet, like so many people from all parts of New York and throughout the country, we still needed assistance from the government to survive. I’m where I am today because my mom and grandma taught me to dream big and create my own destiny – in spite of the odds and the naysayers. It’s why I fought and worked to make my way to Stanford, then served in the Obama Administration and made it to Harvard Law. When people said a guy who didn’t come from money and wasn’t part of the establishment could never win a House primary over wealthy and well-known opponents, I made history as the first openly gay, Black member of Congress. Earlier today, my cousin texted me this photo. I had never seen it before. It’s a photo of me at a time when I desperately wanted to change the world – to make it fair for kids like me – but had no idea I could. As I reflect on my 35 years on Earth, I think of the boy in that picture and how far I have come with your help. My experiences as a child shaped me into who I am today, but I know that others have not been so lucky to beat the unfair odds against them. That’s why I fight every single day to make sure other children, regardless of the circumstances of their birth, can dream big and achieve their dreams. The little boy in that photo would be proud of the work we accomplished this term. Cutting child poverty in half and keeping schools and small businesses open through the American Rescue Plan. Playing a lead role in passing the largest investment in infrastructure in our nation’s history, which will create millions of good-paying jobs over the next decade. Then co-authoring the Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act to save our democracy from the threats of the far-right. I will never stop fighting for working people in Congress, regardless of the district. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = | = = | = | = Thank you for your continued support, and always remember to dream big about what we can accomplish together. clean_body: Voters want representatives who will do something. | | | Peter, so many voters across the country are all in for electing real Democrats to Congress and fighting back against obstructionists like Kyrsten Sinema and Joe Manchin. In last night’s primary elections, voters rejected Sinema-like candidates in favor of candidates who unequivocally support Biden’s agenda. Specifically, in Oregon, incumbent Kurt Schrader is about to lose his seat. Schrader, a shill for Big Pharma, sabotaged lower drug prices last year. It’s clear, voters are sick and tired of obstructionist “Democrats” like Schrader and Sinema who screw over their constituents in favor of doing their millionaire donors' bidding. Voters are sending a clear message: Not listening to your constituents and blocking President Biden’s agenda isn’t going to fly. Many of the candidates who won, like Pennsylvania’s Democratic Senate nominee John Fetterman, campaigned as a foil to Kyrsten Sinema and Joe Manchin and promised to “always be that 51st vote.” It’s clear Democrats across the country want action from people in office. We’re ecstatic to see the growing number of real Democrats elected to Congress who can make Sinema’s vote less and less consequential. But we’ve still got another critical test in just six days: the “Sinema of the House” Henry Cuellar has his run-off election on May 24th — and we need to make sure he loses. body:
Friends -
Thank you for putting your faith in me as the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in North Carolina. It’s humbling.
The Republican primary has been called, and our opponent is Trump-endorsed Congressman, Ted Budd.
I’ll tell you more about his radical and harmful agenda in a moment, but with the general election officially underway, I need to ask for your immediate support to start strong.
If you can, please split a $15 donation between our campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand right now to become a Founding General Election Donor and flip this seat. [http://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/beasley_gfs?refcode=jtk3458-bu-nd]
Look, there’s a reason that this was one of the first Senate races Donald Trump got involved in this cycle. Ted Budd was one of Trump’s first endorsements because he’s proven himself a loyal foot soldier.
Ted Budd pushed Trump’s Big Lie and voted to overturn the election on January 6. He wants to ban abortions — even for cases of rape, incest or where the mother’s life is at risk.
He voted against the bipartisan infrastructure plan and sided with Big Pharma by voting against legislation to lower prescription drug prices. And he believes in tax cuts for big corporations and oil companies already making record profits paid for by us, while our families struggle with higher costs.
Ted Budd is a DC insider who looks out for himself and the big corporations and special interests who fund his campaigns, not North Carolina.
He must be stopped, and right now, the latest polling shows us tied at 45%. The Senate majority could come down to a handful of votes in this race, and we’re counting on a lot of grassroots support to make sure we have the resources to win.
Can you please split a $15 donation between our campaign to flip North Carolina’s open Senate seat and Kirsten Gillibrand today? We need as many Founding General Election Donors as possible to prove that Democrats have what it takes to win and expand the majority. [1]Charles Booker

It’s official,
Peter. I am Kentucky’s Democratic
nominee for Senate, running against Rand Paul.

The Commonwealth of Kentucky has never had a Black person be at the top of
the ticket — but last night, we changed that.

Peter, if anybody
tells you change is not possible...tell 'em look at Kentucky.

In November, we will make history by defeating Rand Paul and expanding our
Senate majority. We’re going to finally pass the urgent policies our
communities need to survive like Medicare for All and student debt
cancellation. And we’re going to make sure that Mitch McConnell is NEVER
majority leader again.

The challenges we face here in the Commonwealth and across the country are
real. And they’re not going to go away by us wishing, or waiting for Rand
Paul to do something about it. We’re going to lead ourselves.

I’m running to replace Rand Paul because the cost of inaction is too high.

I’ve lived in poverty. I’ve been unhoused. I’ve lost family members to gun
violence. I am still paying off my student loans. And I know that when our
politicians ignore these struggles, our pain only continues.

Together, we have the power to change the future of Kentucky. But this
kind of deep organizing work requires significant resources and funding.

can kick off this work to replace Rand Paul.

I want you to know I am honored to be on this journey with you. Thank you
for believing,
Peter.

— Charles

| | | **Updates from the Campaign Trail******
Friends,
I appreciate your ongoing support of my campaign. We are working hard to connect with voters and businesses throughout District 7 and wanted to send just a few updates of our non-stop campaign. Together we can change the trajectory of this administration and protect our conservative values. Full speed ahead with under 100 days until the Primary. #ErikaforAmerica
Thank you for your continued support!Erika Benfield

---
| | | | | | |
---
**SMALL BUSINESS WEEK SPOTLIGHT: **In today's economy, with families struggling to pay increasing gas prices and struggling to find essentials like baby formula on grocery store shelves, it is vital to have someone in Congress who understands the struggles of everyday people. Erika's small business experience is shining through this campaign and her company was recently spotlighted in Florida Living Quarters National Small Business Week Spotlight. In addition to running a campaign, Erika opened her new offices this week and is a active member of the small business community.
| | |

Over the last several weeks, my campaign has come under attack from Democrats who don't like it when I stand up for our conservative values.

Even though the Republican Party nomination isn't until [this Saturday](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=89856cde81&e=fc83fb200d), Democrats are getting a head start on attacking me.

Since Wexton, the Democrat Congressional Campaign Committee, and others are starting now to get a head start against me, [I need your support today to help me fight back and keep up with them.](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=5de1efab44&e=fc83fb200d)

The Democrats don't like it when I stand up to protect unborn babies in the womb and put an end to abortion.

On May 21st, voting will be open from 9am-4pm. Your voting location is determined by where you live, and you will not be allowed to vote anywhere other than your designated voting location. You can find a full list of voting locations at [www.JeanineLawson.com/Voting](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=e8f106c98b&e=fc83fb200d)

For additional help determining your voting location, please call 571-484-4425 or email [info@jeaninelawson.com](mailto:info@jeaninelawson.com) and we can help you determine where to vote.

**Prince William County: **your voting location will be determined by your magisterial district.

If you live in **Brentsville District represented by Supervisor Jeanine Lawson** , your voting location will be Gainesville Middle School located at 8001 Limestone Drive, Gainesville.

If you live in **Gainesville District represented by Supervisor Pete Candland**, your voting location will be Bull Run Middle School located at 6308 Catharpin Road, Gainesville.

If you live in **Coles District represented by Supervisor Yesli Vega or in Occoquan District**, your voting location will be Lake Jackson Fire Station located at 11310 Coles Drive, Manassas.

**Loudoun County: **Your voting location will be determined by your magisterial district _unless you live in Blue Ridge District represented by Supervisor Tony Buffington._

If you live in **Blue Ridge district** , your district is split between two voting locations. Find your precinct by visiting the [State Board of Elections website](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=28d7a6d250&e=fc83fb200d).
Blue Ridge precincts 301, 302, 303, 305, 308, 310, 311, and 315 vote at Loudoun Valley High School.
Blue Ridge precincts 307, 309, 312, 313, 314, 316, 318, 319, 320, 321, and 322 vote at Mercer Middle School.

If you live in **Catoctin, Leesburg, or portions of Blue Ridge** districts, your voting location will be Loudoun Valley High School located at 340 N. Maple Avenue, Purcellville.

If you live in **Algonkian, Ashburn, or Broad Run** districts, your voting location is Broad Run High School located at 21670 Ashburn Road, Ashburn.

If you live in **Sterling, Dulles, or portions of Blue Ridge **districts, your voting location is Mercer Middle School located at 42149 Greenstone Drive, Aldie.

**Fauquier County:** Your county-wide voting location will be Fauquier High School located at 705 Waterloo Road, Warrenton.

**Rappahannock County** : Your county-wide voting location will be Rappahannock County Elementary School located at 34 Schoolhouse Road, Washington.

**Fairfax County** : Your voting location for all voters in the 10th district will be the Clifton Town Hall located at 12641 Chapel Road, Clifton.

**Manassas City** : Your city-wide voting location will be Grace E. Metz Middle School located at 9950 Wellington Road, Manassas.

**Manassas Park City** : Your city-wide voting location will be the Manassas Park Community Center located at 99 Adams Street, Manassas Park.

If you have any questions, please call 571-484-4425 or email [info@jeaninelawson.com](mailto:info@jeaninelawson.com)and we can help you determine where to vote.

Texans are voting now in the runoff election!
Early voting opened Monday and runs until May 20. The runoff is on May 24. You can find more information about voting in the runoff here. [https://www.texastribune.org/2022/04/22/texas-voting-primary-runoff-2022/]
https://www.texastribune.org/2022/04/22/texas-voting-primary-runoff-2022/ [https://www.texastribune.org/2022/04/22/texas-voting-primary-runoff-2022/]
The threats to Roe and reproductive freedom remind us of the importance of elections and voting, and these runoff elections will have huge implications for the future of our state and our country.
This weekend, Lizzie joined LGBTQ supporters across the Houston area to celebrate the work of the Victory Fund. Along with Victory Fund President and former Houston Mayor Annise Parker, the crowd heard from organization representatives and elected allies who are all committed to increasing the diversity in our representative government.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/4F337734344B75524C442F493167626746783452314364306A774C2B484C2B6A4C4C65774C36676456756A4F3771685948575561714C4432454A584C442F7438/editor_images/Screen%20Shot%202022-05-18%20at%2010.01.13%20AM.png]
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/4F337734344B75524C442F493167626746783452314364306A774C2B484C2B6A4C4C65774C36676456756A4F3771685948575561714C4432454A584C442F7438/editor_images/Screen%20Shot%202022-05-18%20at%2010.01.26%20AM.png]
In Congress, Lizzie co-sponsored the Equality Act to protect the LGBTQ+ community by prohibiting discrimination based on sex, sexual orientation, and gender identity in areas including public accommodations and facilities, education, federal funding, employment, housing, credit, and the jury system.
It’s so important — in this election and elections to come — that we work together to elect candidates who will champion equality at every level of government.
Lizzie was on “Houston Matters” to talk about the Supreme Court’s draft opinion overturning Roe v. Wade , what it means for Texans, and what she’s doing to protect reproductive rights.

Thank you for your time!

**August 21 st 2021 marked six years since the fateful late-summer afternoon that changed my life and those of my two best friends - forever.**

**I had just finished serving our great nation in Afghanistan when my best friends and I decided to take a vacation in Europe**. We were traveling on a Paris-bound train when a terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill us all.

As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat -As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. **Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist.**

This split-second decision prevented what witnesses contend could have become a mass slaughter. There is a reason I was able to make this split-second decision to intervene, Fellow Conservative - **I have and always will be willing to give my life in the fight for freedom, in the image of true American values.**

[**At the end of this email, I am going to ask you to donate $6 to my campaign for Congress, in honor of the sixth anniversary of the Thalys train attack. name: Letitia James
subject: Saturday's devastating tragedy in Buffalo
disclaimer_text: Paid for by James for NY
body:
I grieve alongside the loved ones of those who had their lives taken.
| | |
---
Peter,

Saturday’s tragedy in Buffalo is an all-too-common reality: one in which an 18-year-old white supremacist can enter a supermarket in a predominantly Black neighborhood and commit the deadliest mass shooting of 2022.

This attack was blatantly fueled by the shooter's racist, anti-immigrant, and antisemitic beliefs. Among the 10 murdered and three wounded, 11 of the victims were Black.
They were mothers, fathers, grandmothers. A deacon. A sister. A cancer survivor. A friend. They could have been my family. They could have been yours.

I grieve alongside the loved ones of those who had their lives taken. I share their outrage – and I also share their urge to act. I am committed to doing everything in my power to put an end to the gun violence epidemic that has claimed far too many innocent lives in 2022 alone.
**We don't have to accept this tragic reality.**

**That's why, just yesterday, I stood in unity with President Biden and other elected officials to affirm that racism and gun violence have no place in our society. And today, I ****announced that my office will be launching an investigation into the social media channels used by the shooting suspect. These companies allowed hateful and violent language to go unchecked and they must face the consequences of their negligence.**
Thank you for being by my side in this fight for our safety and justice. Thoughts and prayers will never be enough; we must act now.

Letitia James

name: Gisele Barreto Fetterman
subject: This is because of YOU! ❤️
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
From the very start, we’ve been running a clean and honest Democratic campaign.
#
Hi Derek! ❤️❤️❤️
Let me start by saying thank you for all the support you have given João, my family, and this campaign over not just the past few days, but the past year! It all means the world to us.
This campaign is unique in a lot of ways, but especially because of how our campaign is financially supported.
You won’t find any icky, dirty money here, thank you very much! 🙅🏻♀️
From the very start, we’ve been running a clean, honest and kind Democratic campaign (that’s unique too, sadly). That means our campaign has never, and will never, accept dirty corporate PAC money. No million-dollar Wall Street checks. And definitely no money from Big Oil.
Everything this campaign does is fueled by the donations of people who believe in João and our campaign. **When we say we're people-powered, we really mean it.**
But now that João is the official Democratic nominee, we need to take our grassroots enthusiasm to the next level so we can flip this seat blue. That means each and every one of us chipping in what we can, when we can.
[**Derek, can you please make your first donation today to help carry our grassroots momentum and help our people-powered campaign grow? By making a donation today, you’ll become one of our Founding Donors!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220518-3?refcode=em20220518-5878&refcode2=5878_434096_rUotLl&akid=5878%2E434096%2ErUotLl)
No, we’re not going to ask you to make a huge donation you can’t afford. And no, our campaign is never going to ignore our grassroots donors in the name of attracting billionaires and super PACs.
That’s not how we do things.
We’re proud to be people-powered, unlike the Republicans, who will no doubt be spending millions of dollars in an attempt to buy this seat. Which is why it’s even more important that our campaign sticks to its core values.
**[So, Derek, can you make a donation today to become a Founding Donor and show your support for our people-powered movement? Every single dollar makes a huge difference as we head into the general election.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220518-3?refcode=em20220518-5878&refcode2=5878_434096_rUotLl&akid=5878%2E434096%2ErUotLl)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220518-3?amount=5&refcode=em20220518-5878&refcode2=5878_434096_rUotLl&akid=5878%2E434096%2ErUotLl)**
Thank you again. I’m so glad that you are a part of our team.
With love and gratitude,
Gisele ❤️
Gisele Barreto Fetterman
Second Lady of Pennsylvania (SLoP)

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220518-5878-footer&t=1&refcode2=5878_434096_rUotLl&akid=5878%2E434096%2ErUotLl)**

Friend: Getting to meet voters all across our state has been truly unforgettable.
| | |
---
Friend, I have a few free minutes. I know that doesn’t sound like much, but when you’re splitting time between the campaign trail and working to stand up for Florida in Congress, moments like these don’t happen very often. I wanted to take this moment to reflect on my time so far on the campaign trail.
The grassroots movement we're building has never been about gaining national attention or praise. **At its heart, this movement has always been about Florida and making sure that its working families know that I will _never_ stop fighting for them. **
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45477489/346127435/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3202-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDFkOWQ0Yy1mZWQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nOLe2JRdaSzygChbqsYduO3ySFYPJn_susLrXb4TzbI=)
That’s why I'm traveling to every corner of Florida – **from the** **Panhandle to the Keys** – because I will fight for EVERY Floridian in the Senate if I’m elected. There's no county or city too small for me to show up in, listen to and learn from, because I want to serve _every_ Floridian. And I have to say, friend: Getting to meet voters all across our state has been truly **_unforgettable_**.
It has been humbling to have supporters approach me with their stories of resilience, struggle and joy, and to know that each and every one of you is by my side in this race. With every little conversation, every hug and tear shed along the way, I’m reminded all over again of why I’m running: _Floridians deserve better than Marco Rubio. _
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45477490/346127436/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3202-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDFkOWQ0Yy1mZWQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nOLe2JRdaSzygChbqsYduO3ySFYPJn_susLrXb4TzbI=)
But friend, the road to the Senate is still a long one – and we can’t afford to lose momentum now. With Florida’s last Senate race determined by only 10,033 votes, this race WILL come down to resources, and I need your help to ensure that no voter or community is left unreached.
**That’s why I’ve set an ambitious goal to raise $20,000 before MIDNIGHT so that I can continue to reach and connect with voters in every corner of our beautiful state – but I’m still $3,583 short. At its heart, this movement has always been about Florida and making sure that its working families know that I will never stop fighting for them. = That’s why I'm traveling to every corner of Florida – from the Panhandle to the Keys – because I will fight for EVERY Floridian in the Senate if I’m elected. There's no county or city too small for me to show up in, listen to and learn from, because I want to serve every Floridian. And I have to say, friend: Getting to meet voters all across our state has been truly unforgettable. It has been humbling to have supporters approach me with their stories of resilience, struggle and joy, and to know that each and every one of you is by my side in this race. With every little conversation, every hug and tear shed along the way, I’m reminded all over again of why I’m running: Floridians deserve better than Marco Rubio. = But friend, the road to the Senate is still a long one – and we can’t afford to lose momentum now. With Florida’s last Senate race determined by only 10,033 votes, this race WILL come down to resources, and I need your help to ensure that no voter or community is left unreached. That’s why I’ve set an ambitious goal to raise $20,000 before MIDNIGHT so that I can continue to reach and connect with voters in every corner of our beautiful state – but I’m still $3,583 short. = | | = Thank you, Val Demings | | Our grassroots campaign is off to a great start, but in a race as close as this one, I need your help to surge ahead and defend the Senate. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com because you’re critical to this grassroots campaign. To make sure you’re the first to get important updates, or text “JOIN” to 77076 to receive text updates. & . I’m relying on grassroots supporters like you, donating to emails like this, to help me defeat Marco Rubio and stop Mitch McConnell from flipping the Senate. So, please consider =. Peter -- If you are like me, you were at the edge of your seat during the primary elections in Pennsylvania, North Carolina, and Kentucky. Last night John Fetterman won his Pennsylvania U.S. Senate race in a landslide victory! Fetterman unapologetically traveled and spoke to constituents about what matters, ignoring the establishment opposition to a candidate who understands that progressive policies benefit us all. Fetterman is our best hope to flipping this Senate seat in 2022. We are sending him well wishes as he recovers, and will be ready to celebrate soon!

Last night, Summer Lee declared victory with a small lead.

clean_body: | | Peter -- If you are like me, you were at the edge of your seat during the primary elections in Pennsylvania, North Carolina, and Kentucky. Last night John Fetterman won his Pennsylvania U.S. Senate race in a landslide victory! Fetterman unapologetically traveled and spoke to constituents about what matters, ignoring the establishment opposition to a candidate who understands that progressive policies benefit us all. Fetterman is our best hope to flipping this Senate seat in 2022. We are sending him well wishes as he recovers, and will be ready to celebrate soon! | But something bigger was at play last night. Super PACs like American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC), who have backed nearly 100 Republican candidates, is now backing anti-choice candidates. breakdown? Nearly $2.9 million to stop Erica Smith (NC-01). About $2 million came in for Attica Scott's (KY-03) opponent. And over $3.3 million in attack ads against Summer Lee (PA-12). Just a month ago Summer was leading the race by 29 points. In a short period, these Super PACs were able to close that gap. We quickly set out to organize to fight against big money! It paid off. Last night, Summer Lee declared victory with a small lead. | I always say these wins don't come easy. Labor, an army of volunteers, and a coalition of progressive organizations, like Future Generations, Justice Democrats and Working Families Party, all came together to make sure we have the resources and people power needed to fight back against millions. The Texas Runoffs are next Tuesday and we must be able to do what we can to secure a win for Jasmine Crockett in TX-30, and Jessica Cisneros in TX-28. Future Generations is heading to San Antonio until the May 24th election to support Jessica Cisneros defeat Henry Cuellar (also backed by AIPAC and affiliates). Will you help us grow our organizing efforts? | | Dear Friend,Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we've seen a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and against capitalism.
---
| [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
| | **But do they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and capitalism?** This is _precisely_ why we put together this brand new eBook, **[ _The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-gnjwDR-NzC7zB2rNg)**[](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.__GhvLeAjOUYWQ), from Hoover Institution senior fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson. This eBook consists of two papers-one from each scholar-written in conjunction with _The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and Free-Market Capitalism_. This project provides objective and scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and well-being. I think you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely, given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political leaders. **[Simply click here to request your free copy of _The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)** Thanks,Greg Greg Stamps | Online DevelopmentHoover Institution | Stanford University

| | Derek, I remember when we first found out our daughter had type 1 diabetes. We worked so hard to educate ourselves on what we’d need to do to keep her safe and healthy. We shared the same goal as any parent who has a child with diabetes — make sure our kid could have as normal a life as possible. For me, this experience is also a call to action. The price of insulin today is completely out of control. Some people are forced to pay $900 a month for medicine they need to stay alive. I’m fortunate we’ve never had to worry about paying for our daughter’s care — but too many parents in this country can’t afford the medicine their kids urgently need. [_**Congress is considering legislation that would cap the out-of-pocket expenses people pay for insulin at $35/month. Please sign our petition now demanding action on this crucial bill.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45478809/346132132/-556743800?ms=mw_em_220518_1&refcode=mw_em_220518_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwN2FhYjQ0OS0wNmQ3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aWMvxD1TUBz3nu2j0EUJBR3Rh2ZsQ7i-IS6B1TYmhFY=&emci=36346ed9-17d6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=07aab449-06d7-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=4568237) It is morally reprehensible that people in the United States are forced to choose between life-saving medication and putting food on the table, or paying rent, or affording utilities. And it is unconscionable that the skyrocketing price of insulin makes people ration their supplies so it lasts longer — something that can lead to serious complications from the disease, and even death. [_**It is long past time to make insulin affordable and accessible for anyone who needs it. Sign our petition today.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45478810/346132133/-556743800?ms=mw_em_220518_1&refcode=mw_em_220518_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwN2FhYjQ0OS0wNmQ3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aWMvxD1TUBz3nu2j0EUJBR3Rh2ZsQ7i-IS6B1TYmhFY=&emci=36346ed9-17d6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=07aab449-06d7-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=4568237) Thank you, Mark **[ADD Your NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45478811/346132134/-556743800?ms=mw_em_220518_1&refcode=mw_em_220518_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwN2FhYjQ0OS0wNmQ3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aWMvxD1TUBz3nu2j0EUJBR3Rh2ZsQ7i-IS6B1TYmhFY=&emci=36346ed9-17d6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=07aab449-06d7-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=4568237)**

subject: (bump) The Medicare for All Act of 2022
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
We wanted to make sure you saw Alex’s note about Medicare for All
#

Hey there — we wanted to make sure you saw Alex’s note from last week about the re-introduction of Medicare for All, and why he’s proud to be a co-sponsor.
Can you take a minute to read Alex’s email, and then add your name to stand with him as a Citizen Co-Sponsor of the Medicare for All Act of 2022?
**[SIGN ON](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/em-may22-m4a/?source=em220518-1-30&refcode2=809.159979.YjxYaM&akid=809%2E159979%2EYjxYaM)**
Thanks for everything!
Team Padilla

* * *

Friends,
Last week, the Medicare for All Act of 2022 was introduced in the U.S. Senate. I’m a proud co-sponsor of this bill and I’ll tell you why in just a minute, but if you’re already on board, then I’m asking you to join me:
**Will you sign on as a Citizen Co-Sponsor of the Medicare for All Act of 2022? Use this link:**
[**https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/Medicare-for-All**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/em-may22-m4a/?source=em220518-1-30&refcode2=809.159979.YjxYaM&akid=809%2E159979%2EYjxYaM)
It is simply a fact that many communities of color living in the United States have less access to health care, have worse health outcomes, and are less insured than other communities.
But research has shown that something changes when people turn 65 — after that point, there’s a substantial reduction in those racial disparities in health care.
Why is that? Because when people turn 65, they’re eligible for Medicare and they’re able to get the health care they need without going into life-ruining debt.
So what’s the logical plan of action to make sure everyone, including communities of color, have the health care they need? Make everyone eligible for Medicare!
[**Please, sign on as a Citizen Co-Sponsor of the Medicare for All Act of 2022 and help send a message to my colleagues in Congress about support for guaranteeing health care as a human right for ALL of us.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/em-may22-m4a/?source=em220518-1-30&refcode2=809.159979.YjxYaM&akid=809%2E159979%2EYjxYaM)
**[SIGN ON](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/em-may22-m4a/?source=em220518-1-30&refcode2=809.159979.YjxYaM&akid=809%2E159979%2EYjxYaM)**
Nobody should go bankrupt because they can’t afford their medical expenses, and nobody should have to choose between paying hospital bills or putting food on the table for their family.
In other developed nations around the world, ensuring that health care is available to everyone is simply a given... because health care is a right, not a privilege. It's long past time for the United States to transition to a model of Medicare For All.
Thank you for joining the fight to pass Medicare for All and guarantee health care as a human right for ALL of us.
Sincerely,
Alex Padilla
**[SIGN ON](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/em-may22-m4a/?source=em220518-1-30&refcode2=809.159979.YjxYaM&akid=809%2E159979%2EYjxYaM)**

| | Dear Fellow American,
A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?”
This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life.
In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.”
Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism.
Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country.
**Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?**
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=7a1877a48f604bca84f156f0b5513982&_m=4943c83332b74ef9b3e8fa5cacab8c0c&_e=D_lI6cvVg47am6iThe8IoSrf2RhiN-eyoyN4gyfI1rsyYm1dNpz8FYfeyDVsH5dnuDeTV5hW-EhHUEZavFhB3U0lALOlknQy4EqG2C4ohSAD-SZVeXd3_RK4ljCNqJ-DERHRZfdyFqGmdwY-dnWC9cSJgLw_QLRXvmB8yhogue95ZEcFBXuM32ZSlRbo3rC7Hnl_upa05ZofK3Q_Vk8Hibw_nb3cj_I6Wy4TdVpdC95lYi4jrKYWioJ5SztoFun7HV9xeC3rmUSCdobnvrglVrs00ckx42lFhesCc6pagqQ-R2mqVQTINTHRh5VyV_SWkj1MffjPX_QExNYhVpANqyQB9ZF_CIB5V4oCbmc_4qDJBVfsRCu5usNRGvOtUGNyoTz3AkuAByT-ABlRKP3dMMNQFFVpxvicPq_BJPg_Ef4orneW9LTqoGn3y1IT0T2AxLU6aE7M-c01n6Oz63DkO6gWVH-Sin82NOWXn7ylIMw%3D)**
Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that...
**. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. **
**Why is this?**
Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists.
At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried.
This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media.
Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military.
But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous.
You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020.
In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed.
**That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. **
By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.
We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country.
Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical.
As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.”
If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today.
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=7a1877a48f604bca84f156f0b5513982&_m=4943c83332b74ef9b3e8fa5cacab8c0c&_e=D_lI6cvVg47am6iThe8IoSrf2RhiN-eyoyN4gyfI1rsyYm1dNpz8FYfeyDVsH5dnuDeTV5hW-EhHUEZavFhB3U0lALOlknQy4EqG2C4ohSAD-SZVeXd3_RK4ljCNqJ-DERHRZfdyFqGmdwY-dnWC9cSJgLw_QLRXvmB8yhogue95ZEcFBXuM32ZSlRbo3rC7Hnl_upa05ZofK3Q_Vk8Hibw_nb3cj_I6Wy4TdVpdC95lYi4jrKYWioJ5SztoFun7HV9xeC3rmUSCdobnvrglVlyQHXA44iI3iTKCC5TzTvdAPnPNJEaVI3DjwgnfNrHjhJ5dFONuGBf-mwHcGdMp40-TnYB0o1a4iWCtaOTP2GZG9fgybAzyDfV3tbWP1BYEUS5LcP9yPs3zCqAHnzGAV8gGQcSBUBgrAgvBP-u4pTuKYsnLz9zWNo7ZWNit7FxhDXHQIDLENFtdI5YaLF4HBOk39FRe07ducOCo2kK9w0Y%3D)**
Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**.
Warm regards,
Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Why is this? Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to reach and teach millions has never been more urgently needed. That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. By responding to the National Survey on Socialism in the next five days, your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to reach and teach increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the National Survey on Socialism today. Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education. Warm regards, Larry P. | Peter,

My name is Jeremy Hunt.

I’m a former U.S. Army Intelligence Officer, a father, husband, and graduate of West Point.

I’m a native Georgian and a loyal patriot.

I’m also a proud, principled and outspoken Black conservative.

Peter, **I was deployed and spent 2016 in Ukraine training their armed forces on how to respond to external threats to their sovereign territory**.

Now, I’m running for Congress in Georgia’s 2nd congressional district to be a voice in Congress advocating for a strong and robust military. Right now, the number of veterans serving in the House is dwindling by the year, and quite honestly, that’s dangerous.

Oh - and the district in which I’m running? Yea, **it hasn’t been held by a Republican since 1875.** But now the tides have finally turned and I know I’m the man to get the job done.

**If you’re interested, please continue reading for just a few more moments.** If you don’t have the time right now to continue reading, then **[I hope you don’t find it too presumptive of me to ask for a small donation to my congressional campaign today](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=115898b1de324d34866fa8ee88ba22e3&_e=suN3bUpCKPEItuIvA2J7zTxTCuxv4219RiGE5k7quaWNPE3aS_Pn7ijSsUlGWcUOqwoAnTARRW8kYa-7Wlb1bgwf0xwXmKDlrnQGcYfI_dA6xs39JIiNR6Wpt5JUg-_KDpcInhRXnP-lGaixiqQxK_uYhH_iwgDQ6L46swLt6ZY8L_KZWrx6EOEtdQKZskQ6RUu0iT05Fp60OaUtJhoTf42P7G-wXCR_P2grP6zuI6OBLywWf95XU8nclh4dI8FoK1UIcAqVw1rsw0Ifw6kmvYajaH5JJk0CsjCMWP9A9igUsYKSTlTkMdxyegmApPkg-ozgGF692lO0mh9diIO8Lvg0anY2KuHEa2us4JFVMYONKXRzN-_bJ4dGvUkKq0BZ1eL9GoSA8GOIgp08YVzr-HeZqoiFZBzDUmELgqfrYhBEzCI90QmjgcjaG4ivTq_LB71---LaQdzrEiyt2vuMOg%3D%3D)**. We need serious leadership back in Washington, D.C. We don’t need leaders who take weeks and months to make decisions as important as whether to support democracies like Ukraine.

For all of his bluster, Joe Biden is solely responsible for having to shut down not one but TWO American embassies in less than a year. This leadership isn’t leadership at all - it’s an embarrassment. **While Joe and Hunter Biden were making money off Ukrainian gas companies, I was training Ukrainian military members how to defend themselves from evil dictators like Vladimir Putin.**

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=115898b1de324d34866fa8ee88ba22e3&_e=suN3bUpCKPEItuIvA2J7zTxTCuxv4219RiGE5k7quaWNPE3aS_Pn7ijSsUlGWcUOqwoAnTARRW8kYa-7Wlb1bgwf0xwXmKDlrnQGcYfI_dA6xs39JIiNR6Wpt5JUg-_KDpcInhRXnP-lGaixiqQxK_uYhH_iwgDQ6L46swLt6ZY8L_KZWrx6EOEtdQKZskQ6RUu0iT05Fp60OaUtJhoTf42P7G-wXCR_P2grP6zuI6OBLywWf95XU8nclh4dI8FoxAxZdVzxssSrii8fHbya0NMHA9T1xn3dHIdhZ_BOrlu0cecpveATj8SKf3ptrAH0PnuhLhvZcqmgvTkKPvuVPKFL-bgAXSRLMY3xXByeJVCQXPEV29JOIJokPYDdLLUbi_5bBqfuuJeKfcPKd9kKLpNsiTzOz7fZO2iiLOwBTpR94EiVCCzekslPdb2oZ_VNSYkqcUORliJ54RirtYGjxw%3D%3D)

As an Army veteran who spent time on the ground in Ukraine, I can tell you, the warning signs that an invasion was imminent were there for years. **Joe Biden was slow to react and we’re now in a major debacle**.

While Joe and Hunter Biden were making money off Ukrainian gas companies, I was training Ukrainian military members how to defend themselves from evil dictators like Vladimir Putin. Hi Peter, Midnight tonight is the official FEC Pre-Primary deadline. It’s the final deadline before Election Day, where we must show our hand for the homestretch: whether we’ll have the resources to fend off the avalanche of attacks we're facing. With the finish line in sight, after today our opponents will either be emboldened or demoralized. A strong showing can make clear that their cynical tactics won’t derail us. [Can you help me get across the finish line?](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G172QGsW76cwQP_qMTr_tK1&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_may18&n=2) Thanks to your amazing support, we have the momentum. But when you're being targeted like we are, momentum can turn on a dime. As the frontrunner, you get targeted. And as a candidate who is a threat to the status quo, you get targeted. Right now, we are both. To weather the storm and make sure our positive message is what voters remember, [I need your help](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G172QGsW76cwQP_qMTr_tK1&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_may18&n=3). Your support is the armor I can use to fight through this last set of barriers. Your generosity can seal a victory that will rock the political establishment. We've worked so, and there is so much at stake, that we simply can't let up now. We'll be making calls, knocking on doors, and reaching voters in every way through June 7. And we need to keep our message constant with TV, radio, and mail. That’s why this deadline is so important. It will determine whether we have the ability to do that – or whether our opponents’ smears will be what voters hear most through Election Day. Every donation, [in whatever amount you can](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G172QGsW76cwQP_qMTr_tK1&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_may18&n=4), will help us get our message out. That message is this: we will shake up our nation’s Capitol like we’ve shaken up our state’s. We will take on Biden and Pelosi like we’ve taken on Newsom and the Supermajority. We will fight for America like we’ve fought for California. We’ve built the strongest grassroots campaign in the country. But it will all be for naught if we fall short these last few weeks. [You can help make sure that doesn’t happen](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G172QGsW76cwQP_qMTr_tK1&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_may18&n=5). Thank you for your support, and thank you for being in the fight. Kevin p.s. We are getting close to 15,000 individual donations, which would be a huge milestone for our citizens movement. [Can you help us get there](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G172QGsW76cwQP_qMTr_tK1&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_may18&n=6)?

While most politicians just talk, she has a record of getting conservative results. Unlike failed politician Bryce Reeves who once again skipped today’s debate because he is scared to publicly defend his record, Crystal is proud to stand for our conservative values and deliver results for our community. As our Congresswoman, Crystal will stop the out-of-touch Biden-Pelosi-Spanberger progressive agenda of open borders, uncontrolled inflation, bigger government, and unrestricted abortion. Now more than ever, we need a conservative fighter who will show up for us, not a career politician who will run or compromise our values when times get tough.”

Lt. Gov. John Fetterman will be the senatorial nominee, and state representative Summer Lee will be the nominee to fill the PA-12 House seat. Meanwhile, Charles Booker won the Democratic nomination to challenge Sen. Rand Paul (R-KY) for his seat this November. In 2020, Booker narrowly lost to Amy McGrath, a centrist candidate to whom corporate Democrats funneled millions but lost to Mitch McConnell in the general election. Finally, in rural Oregon, Jamie McLeod-Skinner appears to have won her primary, overcoming 7-term conservative incumbent Kurt Schrader. Not only did progressives win those races (while unfortunately falling to incumbents backed by waves of Super PAC spending in races from North Carolina to Oregon), but some of the most notoriously conservative voices in the country lost their’s. Madison Cawthorne lost his GOP congressional primary, as did a candidate endorsed by Trump to serve as Governor of Idaho. On the one hand, that shows how her resources are effectively limitless. Indeed, we’re aiming to hold accountable the most powerful voice in Washington. On the other hand, we tied up $22 million that Pelosi was unable to deploy against progressives in other races—while also forcing her into repeated policy concessions. We’re back now to finish the job and continue the momentum that our movement demonstrated around the country last night. But, as we face off against a dynastic oligarch with a long and continuing history of corruption, we need your support to level the playing field. Meanwhile, Pelosi continues to duck debates for the 35th year, relying on co-opted journalists to construct the cult of personality that surrounds her. clean_body: Last night’s primary results from around the country offered plenty of news worth celebrating! | | | | | Dear Peter, We were excited to watch election returns come in last night, as progressive candidates won key victories in races across the country while some of the most conservative voices lost. In Pennsylvania, progressives won the Democratic nomination for both the U.S. Senate seat and the hotly contested 12th congressional district. Lt. Gov. John Fetterman will be the senatorial nominee, and state representative Summer Lee will be the nominee to fill the PA-12 House seat. Meanwhile, Charles Booker won the Democratic nomination to challenge Sen. Rand Paul (R-KY) for his seat this November. In 2020, Booker narrowly lost to Amy McGrath, a centrist candidate to whom corporate Democrats funneled millions but lost to Mitch McConnell in the general election. Finally, in rural Oregon, Jamie McLeod-Skinner appears to have won her primary, overcoming 7-term conservative incumbent Kurt Schrader. Not only did progressives win those races (while unfortunately falling to incumbents backed by waves of Super PAC spending in races from North Carolina to Oregon), but some of the most notoriously conservative voices in the country lost their’s. Madison Cawthorne lost his GOP congressional primary, as did a candidate endorsed by Trump to serve as Governor of Idaho. In the year that we won the jungle primary alongside her, Nancy Pelosi spent 400% more on her re-election campaign than she did in the previous year. On the one hand, that shows how her resources are effectively limitless. Indeed, we’re aiming to hold accountable the most powerful voice in Washington. On the other hand, we tied up $22 million that Pelosi was unable to deploy against progressives in other races—while also forcing her into repeated policy concessions. We’re back now to finish the job and continue the momentum that our movement demonstrated around the country last night. But, as we face off against a dynastic oligarch with a long and continuing history of corruption, we need your support to level the playing field. We hope you celebrate last night’s victories! We continue working to give you a few more reasons to celebrate after the primary currently underway wraps up on June 7. Because the press has affirmatively abdicated its constitutional function and continues to whiteout not only our campaign, but the election altogether, most San Franciscans don’t even realize that Pelosi is up for re-election. Meanwhile, Pelosi continues to duck debates for the 35th year, relying on co-opted journalists to construct the cult of personality that surrounds her. Your support helps us work around those obstacles to inform San Franciscans about the choices that the bipartisan corporate establishment doesn’t want our neighbors to hear. Thanks for standing with us—and with the future! Your voice, Shahid PS – Want to do more, beyond donating to extend our reach? with us, or join us for mobilizations this Saturday, or next Sunday, ! | ---|---|--- | | | Paid for by Shahid Buttar for Congress Committee, 1390 Market St., Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94102 | | Sent via . name: Crystal Cavalier for Congress
subject: Post Election Check In
body:
Let's come together on June 5th!

| [ ](http://crystalcavalier.nationbuilder.com/?e=48a1fa12922bf6601cd5922bccf65622&utm_source=crystalcavalier&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=post&n=1)
---
Friend -- Swimming in the waters of a dominant system that conditions us for immediacy and binaries (win or lose, happy or sad, now or never), we must actively choose to embrace wholeness and process. While we did not win yesterday’s primary, over 1,000 individuals cast their ballots for Crystal, a first-time, working-class, grassroots candidate in a competitive district announced less than 3 months before the election. Every vote cast for Crystal was a win. There is no way to quantify the hope and activation that this campaign has brought into the lives of so many. Our list of new supporters and co-conspirators is long. There is no metric for the relationships and collaborations that have been fostered on the campaign trail. Countless seeds of change were planted, and germination takes time. Everything we have achieved is because of our collective work. We are in awe of the dedication of our supporters, and how far we've spread Crystal’s message of unity and grassroots power in such a short amount of time. Our team has many days of reflection and integration ahead. **We look forward to sharing our insights and discussing next steps with you at our June 5th celebration in Pleasant Grove.** The event will be followed by an outdoor film screening by [7 Directions of Service.](https://crystalcavalier.nationbuilder.com/r?u=2MXKF4ARM_wfs5I3vsQyYLtYeZM9t7HzghZyxWd_lYIp4Hmusk45gQGiZJ__FHod&e=48a1fa12922bf6601cd5922bccf65622&utm_source=crystalcavalier&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=post&n=2) Bring your friends and family! | [](https://crystalcavalier.nationbuilder.com/r?u=uuUyPGiVHWR_V3cUbcvCWYT5GAAYfCKfPrDVDaMJ8vQLcP25udDwpEdVj2LT1I_wDjUvYOfy3icHmkbOkkXDA1WWzRrzzGbqRt3YoFk-jXuaFEAzQgu0QPVgXnXIf7yW&e=48a1fa12922bf6601cd5922bccf65622&utm_source=crystalcavalier&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=post&n=3 "RSVP!") subject: Summer Lee went up against dark money and WON
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Dark money has never emmassed like this before and it’s all in response to people like Summer and Alexandria pushing progressive priorities and fighting for working people.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220518-3037-header&t=1&akid=3037%2E2526796%2ERCb1c7)
Yesterday, against an obscene amount of dark money, **Summer Lee pulled off a stunning victory.**
Alexandria endorsed Summer Lee because she understands the realities of working people and is dedicated to the fight for justice for ALL.
Last night’s victory demonstrates the strength of the growing, organized progressive and democratic socialist movement. Summer Lee was outspent 2:1 by dark money groups, but we know that people power is stronger than special interests. Big money groups may be evolving in their tactics, but so are we in fighting back _and winning._

The political establishment does not know the first damn thing about the true meaning of “service.” [**DRAIN THE SWAMP**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=7ff3cefc902b44aaaa4fc1a6284af011&_e=DHhJA-cKIaygrc16n6kNokMP6SWHO8XNw8m0gBdV_56UyLOTQD5yDk7vMv5jKzwtinmRgO-vxH6UEJUpsWOG_BThtCQtFsGweXrEd7yKNAiuer-s7rK3y36TLOlyOZD17Fd8jJ_kS9KJDT8HgJmh9nc_Cki8vb1dfGDnScrBLYikUKeEs2WxdO2r9M0Smri2oozOkkeB1H1sPmn4KNp52nKrdjEP7Q1aZwUiULXQTzOJA7GGy4kdMZvM8ALZWE4jQFDGTlbXhrxtdPuBQghHfG5s07l207Q1MD86r7T-oLL1MUXqmBLIKqlqW2-WKtT7czeP2aiIlYt_BEUB3Ha-0fxbovODav9kjkgfS2pJqeiy7Ac7KFkI21aVq-fY_fF8eaMeHWvle86tDW2pjSRYyLLnGAlKT78cKaYbAqskP29azK1wW9L91S1yrwPcIR-z9euC8am9_CuT3H_DiMjMTsHvZaPJS9uaXxvGELGMKke5YmjosL4ks065350GKICuHbCEtaQvlLOw2uNwAhqphg%3D%3D) On the contrary, I have spent my entire adult life serving my country.

I’d do it all over again if my country needed me.

**THAT is service. THAT is sacrifice. THAT is patriotism.**

I’m running for Congress because I have had it up to my eyeballs with the same old, same old swampy BS.

subject: Victory for Summer Lee and Andrea Salinas!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Even in the face of unprecedented special interest spending, Summer and Andrea proved that grassroots, people-powered movements can still win.
#
Peter,
Our progressive coalition in the House is about to get bigger: **Summer Lee (PA-12) and Andrea Salinas (OR-06) won their primaries yesterday!** I was proud to support both of their campaigns because they are strong progressives who will stand up to corporate greed and fight hard on behalf of the people in Congress.
**Even in the face of unprecedented special interest spending, Summer and Andrea proved that grassroots, people-powered movements can still win.**
But we can't stop now. Our endorsed candidates **Jasmine Crockett (TX-30)** and **Michelle Vallejo (TX-15)** have runoff elections in Texas on Tuesday, and we must sustain this momentum. [**Can you chip in $3 or any amount to help us keep up the fight to elect more people-first leaders to Congress and protect our Democratic majority?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13864?refcode=em20220518-1272&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1272%2E420207%2EXcPfhj)
**[Contribute $3 »](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13864?refcode=em20220518-1272&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=1272%2E420207%2EXcPfhj)**
I'd be remiss if I didn't thank **Nida Allam** and **Erica Smith** for running unapologetically people-first campaigns in NC-04 and NC-01, respectively. While their campaigns came up short, they didn't go down without a fight and built a groundswell of support for our progressive agenda in North Carolina that won't be going away anytime soon.
I first ran for office because I didn't see enough leaders prioritizing the issues that impacted my community the most. Believe me, taking on the corporate interests who want nothing but to protect the broken status quo is never easy. Sometimes we win, and sometimes we fall short — **but no matter the result, every people-first leader who is brave enough to take on the naysayers and speak truth to power helps to create the conditions for a Congress that is more responsive to the people.**
So what do you say, Peter? [**Let's celebrate everything Summer, Andrea, Nida, and Erica accomplished yesterday by continuing our fight. Chip in $3 or any amount to fuel our midterm electoral organizing work.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13864?refcode=em20220518-1272&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1272%2E420207%2EXcPfhj)
In solidarity,
Pramila

---

| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.
