name: Summer Lee
subject: We won
body:
From the bottom of my heart, I want to say thank you to each and every supporter of this movement.
#
Peter — last night, we made history.
[](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/106876?refcode=em20220518-23437&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=23437%2E1203867%2EcaN3S-)
Together, as a multiracial, multigenerational movement, we proved that a grassroots, people-powered campaign can defeat the millions in corporate Super PAC money trying to take us down.
**You were with me all the way. And so was Justice Democrats** , helping me strategize, organize, and run a winning campaign from the very beginning. We stuck together even while facing millions in attack ads. We were stronger than the attacks, Peter.
**They had the money. We had the people. The people won.**
[Justice Democrats needs our support if we want to continue lifting up working-class progressives and winning more primaries. So, can you contribute $3 to Justice Democrats right now to keep up our momentum?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/106876?refcode=em20220518-23437&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=23437%2E1203867%2EcaN3S-)
**[Contribute](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/106876?refcode=em20220518-23437&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=23437%2E1203867%2EcaN3S-)**
Now they will never be able to say that we can’t win on a ballot by and for working class people. And they'll never be able to say that we can't win fighting for clean air and water, Medicare for All, and a quality education for every single child.
We showed them throughout this race that when we build coalitions of people of all races, religions, genders, and ages and come together we can't be stopped.
**From the bottom of my heart, I want to say thank you to each and every supporter of this movement. This is only the beginning, and together we'll take this momentum for bold, progressive change all the way to Congress.**
And we need to win some more primaries before November, Peter. Justice Democrats has more Democratic primaries in 2022 where working-class progressive fighters will take on the establishment. They helped lift my campaign up and we need to do the same for others right now.
[Can you donate $3 to Justice Democrats today so we can keep building progressive power in the Democratic Party?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/106876?refcode=em20220518-23437&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=23437%2E1203867%2EcaN3S-)
**[Contribute](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/106876?refcode=em20220518-23437&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=23437%2E1203867%2EcaN3S-)**
I am honored and grateful to be the Democratic nominee for Pennsylvania's 12th Congressional seat. Now it’s time for the next fight, as Justice Democrats try to win even more primaries, including Jessica Cisneros’ primary next week.
Thank you for believing that a young Black woman from the Mon Valley can bring our bold, progressive vision to Congress. I will continue to fight for our community, no matter what.
Forever grateful,
Summer

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20220518-23437-footer&t=24&refcode2=23437_1203867_caN3S-&akid=23437%2E1203867%2EcaN3S-)**

Fellow Conservative,

My name is General Mick McGuire and I’m running against Democrat Mark Kelly in Arizona’s critical Senate race.

Thanks to Kelly and the Senate Democrats woke mob agenda - Americans are suffering. Our border is wide open, violent crime has skyrocketed, Americans are paying $5 a gallon, and inflation is at a record high.

We are in the midst of a fight for our country and we need to elect proven leaders to lead us to victory.

Fellow Conservative, as a two-star general I’ve fought many battles for our country and WON. I’ve had experience flying F-16s in combat over Baghdad, commanding over 8,300 Arizona National Guard Troops, and protecting our southern border.

When I see a problem, I run towards it, which is exactly why I joined this Senate race. **Mark Kelly** is no different. While he pledged to be YOUR independent voice in the Senate - he has instead chosen to vote strictly along party lines, voting 97.7% of the time with Biden’s agenda and continues to ignore the issues here in Arizona.

**Mark Kelly** voted for Justice Kentanji Brown Jackson to the Supreme Court - despite her lenient sentences for violent sex offenders.

**Mark Kelly** has ignored the crisis at our border which has allowed hundreds of thousands of illegal immigrants to flood our communities and jeopardize our children’s safety.

**Mark Kelly** has refused to act while Americans are suffering from record unemployment and record inflation.

We need to restore our traditional American values.
**_I pledge allegiance to the flag of the United States of America and to the Republic for which it stands, one nation under God, indivisible, with liberty and justice for all._**
Whatever happened to the Pledge of Allegiance Peter?

Hey guys,

Making this quick because, well – you’ve seen the election results. This race is as tight as it gets, and we are likely headed to a recount.

We began our week on Monday with an early drive to Farson (with a fantastic lunch at the Community Center). From there we had stops, meetings, and town halls in Evanston, Cokeville, Jackson, Alpine, Riverton, Lander, Rawlins, Casper, and Gillette. We finished up on Saturday with a brief stop at Devils Tower National Monument, and enjoyed the Crook County Lincoln Day Dinner in Sundance. Our team is working hard to get small signs distributed and our larger signs put up across the state. If you would like a sign please contact Jake at [Jake@hagemanforwyoming.com](mailto:Jake@hagemanforwyoming.com "Jake@hagemanforwyoming.com"). As we move in to parade season, please let us know if you would like to help us with putting together a float or a group of parade walkers in your area to represent Hageman for Wyoming! For Wyoming, Team Hageman --- **Around Wyoming! ** Between Monday and Wednesday (May 9 to 11) Harriet held town halls and meetings in Farson, Evanston, Cokeville, Jackson, Alpine, Riverton, Lander, and Rawlins. We were in Casper on Friday night, and Gillette and Sundance on Saturday. Our events are growing in size—we had over 60 people for the town hall in Evanston, and over 150 in attendance in Alpine! Harriet has talked a lot about accountability while on the campaign, and has committed to returning to every county every year once she is elected. Remember, our Representatives work for us! --- --- --- --- Views From the Road It was another week of beauty on the road in Wyoming. If you’ve been traveling across our great state as well, you may have noticed the landscape is changing a bit- Hageman for Congress 4x8s are popping across the state! clean_body: | | | | Friends, Welcome back to the “Weekly Wyoming Wrap-Up.” It was a busy week on the trail. We began our week on Monday with an early drive to Farson (with a fantastic lunch at the Community Center). From there we had stops, meetings, and town halls in Evanston, Cokeville, Jackson, Alpine, Riverton, Lander, Rawlins, Casper, and Gillette. We finished up on Saturday with a brief stop at Devils Tower National Monument, and enjoyed the Crook County Lincoln Day Dinner in Sundance. Our team is working hard to get small signs distributed and our larger signs put up across the state. If you would like a sign please contact Jake at mailto:Jake@hagemanforwyoming.com "Jake@hagemanforwyoming.com"). As we move in to parade season, please let us know if you would like to help us with putting together a float or a group of parade walkers in your area to represent Hageman for Wyoming! For Wyoming, Team Hageman Around Wyoming! Between Monday and Wednesday (May 9 to 11) Harriet held town halls and meetings in Farson, Evanston, Cokeville, Jackson, Alpine, Riverton, Lander, and Rawlins. We were in Casper on Friday night, and Gillette and Sundance on Saturday. Our events are growing in size—we had over 60 people for the town hall in Evanston, and over 150 in attendance in Alpine! Harriet has talked a lot about accountability while on the campaign, and has committed to returning to every county every year once she is elected. Remember, our Representatives work for us! Views From the Road It was another week of beauty on the road in Wyoming. If you’ve been traveling across our great state as well, you may have noticed the landscape is changing a bit- Hageman for Congress 4x8s are popping across the state! For Harriet, the appearance of green grass is even more exciting, as it is a sign of much-needed moisture and the filling of our reservoirs. Flat Creek North of Jackson HWY 287 Southeast of Lander Devil’s Tower In the News Harriet spent an hour with 1480 KRAE. Upcoming Events! We have numerous planned events throughout this spring and summer, with more being added each week. Please help us spread the word by sharing this information. You can stay informed about our upcoming events by visiting our "Facebook") page or our website, "").
